cards.title: Highwaymen
cards.rules: Three masked riders block the road. Your money or your life. Hands up, then roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! They take the money and your boots. Drink 6, hands still up.
They take the money. Drink 3, hands still up.
You take their horses. Give 3.
Natural 20! You take their horses and their masks. Give 6.

cards.title: The Toll Gate
cards.rules: A gate guard wants papers. Left neighbor plays him: talk your way past in 10 seconds, or drink 3.

cards.title: Wolf Pack
cards.rules: Eyes in the trees, then teeth. Howl at them, then roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! They drag you off the road. Drink 6, then howl at your left neighbor.
They circle and bite. Drink 3, and howl once more.
They scatter into the trees. Give 3.
Natural 20! The alpha rolls over. Everyone else howls; the quietest drinks 6.

cards.title: Goblin Scouts
cards.rules: Two goblins on one stolen pony, both steering. Hold out your reins, then roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! The pony kicks you twice. Drink 6, then neigh at your right neighbor.
The pony runs you over. Drink 3 and neigh.
They fall off. Loot their saddlebags. Give 2.
Natural 20! They fall off, and the pony likes you better. Give 4, and everyone neighs.

cards.title: Wanted Poster
cards.rules: A wanted poster on a tree looks like one of you. On three, everyone points. Most fingers: drink 2.

cards.title: Snake in the Road
cards.rules: A snake crosses the road. Last to lift both feet off the floor drinks 2.

cards.title: Giant Spider
cards.rules: It hangs over the road, waiting. Wiggle eight fingers at it, then roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Wrapped up for later. Drink 6, then spider-walk to the door and back.
Bitten. Drink 3, then spider-walk to the door and back.
Squished under a cartwheel. Give 3.
Natural 20! Squished, and its web held a purse of gold. Give 6.

cards.title: The Tax Collector
cards.rules: The tax collector wants his cut. Right neighbor plays him: thumb war, best of three. Lose: drink 4.

cards.title: Hedge Witch
cards.rules: A woman in a hat of twigs is cursing travelers for fun. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! The curse lands. Drink 6.
The curse lands. Drink 3.
You knock her hat off. Give 3 to whoever looks most cursed.
Natural 20! You knock her hat off. Give 6 to whoever looks most cursed.

jinx.name: Toad Voice
jinx.rule: The cursed player croaks after every sentence. Forgets: drink 1.

cards.title: Bats Under the Bridge
cards.rules: Light the fuse. Pass a cup clockwise, naming a weapon as you pass. The bats hit whoever holds it.

timer.end: The bats swoop. Whoever is holding the cup drinks 3.

cards.title: The Rope Bridge
cards.rules: A rope bridge, one plank wide. Walk heel to toe across the room and back. Wobble: drink 3.

cards.title: The Sphinx
cards.rules: A sphinx sits across the road. Your left neighbor asks a riddle: 10 seconds, or drink 3.

cards.title: The Stuck Cart
cards.rules: A cart is stuck in the mud. Push it: wall-sit for 30 seconds. Stand early: drink 3.

cards.title: The Stare-Down
cards.rules: A knight blocks the road and stares. Right neighbor plays him. Blink or laugh first: drink 3.

cards.title: Mud Pit
cards.rules: The road turns to knee-deep mud. Roll d20 to pull free.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! You leave a boot behind. Drink 4, and stay one shoe down until your next turn.
You leave a boot behind. Drink 2, and stay one shoe down until your next turn.
You pull free. Give 2.
Natural 20! You pull free and moonwalk out. Everyone copies it; the worst moonwalk drinks 4.

cards.title: Tripwire
cards.rules: Bandits strung a wire across the road at shin height. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! You eat the road. Drink 4.
You eat the road. Drink 2.
You hop it. Give 2 to the clumsiest player here.
Natural 20! You hop it. Give 4 to the clumsiest player here.

cards.title: Runaway Cart
cards.rules: A cart full of cabbages comes down the hill. Nobody is driving it. Roll d20 to dive.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Flattened. Drink 6, lying down if you can.
Flattened. Drink 3, lying down if you can.
You dive clear. Give 2 to whoever didn't flinch.
Natural 20! You dive clear. Give 4 to whoever didn't flinch.

cards.title: Falling Acorns
cards.rules: An acorn bonks you on the head, and you're Thumb Master now. Drink 1, then use it.

jinx.name: Thumb Master
jinx.rule: Whenever the cursed player puts a thumb on the table, the last to copy drinks 1.

cards.title: Lost Pilgrims
cards.rules: A line of pilgrims has decided you're the prophet. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! You lead the hymn. Drink 4, then sway with your right neighbor.
You lead the hymn. Drink 2, then sway with your right neighbor.
You point them to the next town. Give 2.
Natural 20! You point them to the next town. Give 4.

cards.title: Wandering Minstrels
cards.rules: Three minstrels sing at you for coin. Sing them a line back, then roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! They follow you for a mile. Drink 4.
They follow you for a mile. Drink 2.
You out-sing them. Give 2.
Natural 20! You out-sing them. Give 4.

cards.title: Stampede
cards.rules: A herd of cattle comes down the road, and it runs clockwise from you. Roll four dice.

dice.instruction: It tramples four seats. You drink {first}; the next three clockwise drink {second}, {third} and {fourth}.

cards.title: Pickpocket
cards.rules: A small boy keeps bumping into you. Your purse is lighter every time. Roll 2d6.

outcomes.instruction: He's gone, and so is your purse. Drink 3.
You catch him by the collar. Make someone turn out their pockets, then give 3.

dice.doubles: He robs everyone else instead. Everyone else drinks 3.

cards.title: The Low Branch
cards.rules: Your right neighbor holds out an arm as the branch. Limbo under it. Touch it: drink 3.

cards.title: Rotten Plank
cards.rules: One plank on the bridge is not like the others. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! It snaps under you. Drink 4.
It snaps under you. Drink 2.
You step over it like a cat. Meow, then give 2.
Natural 20! You step over it like a cat. Meow, then give 4.

cards.title: The Wedding Party
cards.rules: A whole wedding party on the road, and they're one guest short. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Invited. Drink 4, then give a toast to the couple.
Invited. Drink 2, then give a toast to the couple.
You send them the long way round. Give 2.
Natural 20! You send them the long way round. Give 4.

cards.title: The Black Knight
cards.rules: He has held this crossing for years and lets no one pass. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Knocked flat. Drink 8, then bow to him.
Knocked flat. Drink 4, then bow to him.
He yields, finally. Give 4.
Natural 20! He yields, finally. Give 8.

cards.title: The Sheriff
cards.rules: The sheriff says you match a description. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! The stocks. Drink 8 and name three things you didn't do.
The stocks. Drink 4 and name three things you didn't do.
You bribe him, and he drops his badge. Give 4.
Natural 20! You bribe him, and he drops his badge. Give 8.

cards.title: The Bandit Queen
cards.rules: Every bandit in the woods answers to her, and they're all here. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Robbed blind. Drink 8.
Robbed blind. Drink 4.
You take her crown, and her gang scatters. Give 4.
Natural 20! You take her crown, and her gang scatters. Give 8.

spoils.name: Bandit Queen's Crown
spoils.rules: +1 max heart. Every heal heals 1 more.

spoils.name: Queen's Dagger
spoils.rules: +1 to monster d20s. Comes with a Healing Potion.

cards.title: The Witch Hunter
cards.rules: He hunts witches, and he has decided you count. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Dunked in the river. Drink 8, holding your breath.
Dunked in the river. Drink 4, holding your breath.
You convince him he's the witch. Give 4.
Natural 20! You convince him he's the witch. Give 8.

cards.title: The Bridge Troll
cards.rules: He wants a toll. Side bets: thumbs up or down on you; wrong bets drink 1. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! He takes the toll out of you. Drink 8.
He takes the toll out of you. Drink 4.
He falls off his own bridge. Give 5.
Natural 20! He falls off, and pays you a toll. Everyone else drinks 3.

spoils.name: Troll's Club
spoils.rules: +1 to boss d20s. Comes with a Tower Shield.

phases.rules: He climbs back up, dripping. Arm-wrestle your left neighbor, playing the troll. Lose: drink 3.

cards.title: The Robber Baron
cards.rules: He says he owns this road, and everyone on it. Kneel, then roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! His court finds you guilty, and broke. Finish your drink.
His court finds you guilty. Drink 4.
You take his keep. Give 5.
Natural 20! You take his keep. Give 10.

jinx.name: My Lord
jinx.rule: Everyone calls the cursed player My Lord. Slip: drink 1.

phases.rules: His court is in session. Plead your case to the table for 20 seconds; they vote. Guilty: drink 3.

cards.title: The Ogre
cards.rules: An ogre blocks the road. Side bets: thumbs up or down on you; wrong bets drink 1. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! He eats your lunch, then you. Finish your drink.
He takes a bite. Drink 4.
You trick him into a sack. Give 5.
Natural 20! You trick him into a sack. Give 10.

phases.rules: He gets up and swings a tree at you. Roll 2d6.

outcomes.instruction: The tree connects. Drink 4.
You duck it. Give 4.

dice.doubles: He hits himself with it. Give 6.

jinx.name: Ogre Talk
jinx.rule: The cursed player speaks only in one-word grunts. Uses two words: drink 1.

cards.title: The Great Boar
cards.rules: A cart-sized boar. Side bets: thumbs up or down on you; wrong bets drink 1. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Gored. Drink 8.
Gored. Drink 4.
You bring it down. Give 5.
Natural 20! You bring it down, and dinner is served. Everyone else drinks 3.

phases.rules: It turns and charges again, tusks first. Roll d6.

outcomes.instruction: Trampled. Drink 4.
Tusked. Drink 3.
You dodge. Give 3.
You grab a tusk and hang on. Give 3.
It runs into a tree. Give 4.
You ride it. Everyone else drinks 2.

cards.title: The Headless Rider
cards.rules: A rider with no head, galloping right at you. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! He takes your head for a while. Shut your eyes for 10 seconds, then drink 8.
He swings low. Drink 4.
You knock him out of the saddle. Give 5.
Natural 20! You knock him out of the saddle. Give 10.

spoils.name: Ghost Lantern
spoils.rules: +2 to ambush d20s. Comes with a Smoke Bomb.

phases.rules: He rides back. Left neighbor plays him: rock, paper, scissors, best of three. Lose: drink 3.

jinx.name: Spooked
jinx.rule: The cursed player screams whenever anyone says 'head'. Misses one: drink 1.

cards.title: The Talking Oak
cards.rules: An old oak asks why you're in its forest. Give it a reason, then roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! It isn't convinced, and drops a branch on you. Drink 6.
It isn't convinced, and drops a branch on you. Drink 3.
It laughs, and the branches part. Give 3.
Natural 20! It laughs so hard it drops every acorn it has. Give 6.

cards.title: Pixie Swarm
cards.rules: A swarm of pixies, giggling and pulling your hair. Roll d6.

outcomes.instruction: One gets in your ear. Drink 3, head tilted.
They tie your laces together. Drink 3.
You swat one. Give 2.
You trap them under a hat. Give 3.
You out-giggle them. Give 3.
They adopt you. Everyone else drinks 1.

cards.title: The Silent Druid
cards.rules: Read alone what the druid is thinking, start the clock, then act it out. The table guesses.

timer.end: Time. Someone guessed it? Give 3. Nobody did? Drink 3.

cards.title: The Howling Hag
cards.rules: Howl at the moon against your left neighbor. The table calls the quieter: drink 3.

cards.title: The Fairy Ring
cards.rules: A ring of red mushrooms, and you're standing in it. Dance a little, then roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! You dance until dawn. Drink 6.
The fairies make you keep dancing. Drink 3.
You dance out of the ring. A puff of spores follows you. Give 2.
Natural 20! You dance out of the ring. A puff of spores follows you. Give 4.

cards.title: The Wisp
cards.rules: A little light in the trees, bobbing, leading you off the path. Roll 2d6.

outcomes.instruction: You follow it into a bog. Drink 3, and say 'which way?'
You blow it out like a candle. Give 3 to whoever looks most lost.

dice.doubles: It leads someone else astray. Everyone else drinks 3.

jinx.name: Wisp-Struck
jinx.rule: Nobody may look the cursed player in the eye. Caught: drink 1.

cards.title: The Hollow Log
cards.rules: On three, everyone points at who'd hide in a hollow log first. Most fingers: drink 2.

cards.title: Pinecones!
cards.rules: A pinecone storm in the canopy. Everyone ducks on three; the last to duck drinks 2.

cards.title: The Acorn Sprite
cards.rules: Your right neighbor throws a mimed acorn. Catch it in your mouth. Booed: drink 3.

cards.title: The Bramble Witch
cards.rules: A witch made of thorns, sure you trampled her garden. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! You did trample it. Drink 6, and say sorry to a plant.
You did trample it. Drink 3, and say sorry to a plant.
You compliment her roses. She blushes thorns. Give 3.
Natural 20! You compliment her roses. She blushes thorns. Give 6.

jinx.name: Thorny
jinx.rule: The cursed player says 'ouch' before every sip. Forgets: drink 1.

cards.title: The Elves' Test
cards.rules: Eyes shut; the elves hand you someone's drink. Name whose it is. Wrong: drink 3.

cards.title: The Heron
cards.rules: Stand on one leg like a heron, eyes shut, for 10 seconds. Wobble or peek: drink 3.

cards.title: The Elf Lord's Wine
cards.rules: Review your drink like a very old elf lord for 15 seconds. Crack a smile: drink 3.

cards.title: Ode to an Oak
cards.rules: Praise your right neighbor like an ancient tree for 20 seconds. Anyone laughs: you drink 3.

cards.title: Falling Branches
cards.rules: A storm in the canopy, and the branches start coming down. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Bonked. Drink 6.
Bonked. Drink 3.
You catch the last one. Give 2, and hand someone your 'branch'.
Natural 20! You catch the last one. Give 4, and hand someone your 'branch'.

cards.title: The Mossy Slope
cards.rules: A slope of wet moss, and the path is at the bottom. Stand up, then roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Down on your backside, in green. Drink 4 standing up.
Down on your backside, in green. Drink 2 standing up.
Not a smudge on you. Give 2.
Natural 20! You slide down it like a sled. Give 4.

cards.title: Snares
cards.rules: Hunters' snares all over the path. Some of them twitch. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Snap. Hung up by one ankle. Drink 4.
Snap. Hung up by one ankle. Drink 2.
You tiptoe through. Give 2 to whoever walks loudest.
Natural 20! You tiptoe through. Give 4 to whoever walks loudest.

cards.title: Midge Cloud
cards.rules: A cloud of midges off the pond, and they brought friends. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! In your mouth. Drink 4 with a hand over your glass.
In your mouth. Drink 2 with a hand over your glass.
Swatted. Give 2.
Natural 20! Swatted. Give 4.

cards.title: The Elf Patrol
cards.rules: Four elves who find humans adorable. Name a song you'd sing them, then roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! They pat you on the head. Drink 4.
They pat you on the head. Drink 2.
They're charmed and wave you on. Give 2.
Natural 20! They're charmed and wave you on. Give 4.

cards.title: The Woodpecker
cards.rules: A woodpecker goes to work on the tree beside you. Everyone does a woodpecker; the worst drinks 2.

cards.title: The Green Man
cards.rules: Everyone says 'the forest remembers' as a threat. The table picks the scariest; they give 3.

cards.title: The Moss Troll
cards.rules: A troll covered in moss, and very itchy about it. Roll 2d6.

outcomes.instruction: It scratches on you. Drink 3, then say 'moss troll' five times fast.
You scratch its back for it. Give 3.

dice.doubles: A pair! It scratches itself to sleep. Everyone else drinks 2.

cards.title: Name That Tree
cards.rules: Your left neighbor names three trees, one made up. Spot the fake. Wrong: drink 3.

cards.title: The Sinkhole
cards.rules: Leaves over a hole, and the hole is full of mud. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! You wade through. Drink 4, and squelch.
You wade through. Drink 2, and squelch.
You vault it. Give 2.
Natural 20! You vault it. Give 4.

cards.title: The Hunting Party
cards.rules: A lord's hunting party, and you look a lot like a deer. Shout 'not a deer!', then roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! They're not convinced. Drink 4.
They're not convinced. Drink 2.
They apologize and ride off. Give 2.
Natural 20! They apologize and ride off. Give 4.

cards.title: The Elf Archer
cards.rules: She has never missed, and she's very polite about it. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! An arrow through your hat. Drink 8, and tip it.
An arrow through your hat. Drink 4, and tip it.
You hide behind a tree she can't see around. Give 4.
Natural 20! You hide behind a tree she can't see around. Give 8.

cards.title: The Treant
cards.rules: Two tons of walking oak, and you stepped on its roots. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Stomped. Drink 8, then stomp your feet for 5 seconds.
Stomped. Drink 4, then stomp your feet for 5 seconds.
Firewood. Give 4.
Natural 20! Firewood. Give 8.

cards.title: The Woodcutter
cards.rules: He knows every tree in this forest, and you broke one. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! He makes you stack wood. Drink 8.
He makes you stack wood. Drink 4.
You blame a beaver. He believes you. Give 4.
Natural 20! You blame a beaver. He believes you. Give 8.

spoils.name: Woodcutter's Pack
spoils.rules: +1 satchel slot. Comes with a Tower Shield.

cards.title: The Faerie Bard
cards.rules: A faerie bard who needs a villain for her new song, and has picked you. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! You're the villain of the song. Drink 8, and bow.
You're the villain of the song. Drink 4, and bow.
You hum over her until she gives up. Give 4.
Natural 20! You hum over her until she gives up. Give 8.

cards.title: The Wolf King
cards.rules: He means to eat you first. Side bets: thumbs up or down; wrong bets drink 1. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! He takes a bite. Drink 8.
He takes a bite. Drink 4.
You knock out a fang. Give 5.
Natural 20! He runs off yelping. Everyone else drinks 3.

phases.rules: He circles you. Staring contest with your left neighbor, playing the wolf. Blink first: drink 3.

jinx.name: Howler
jinx.rule: The cursed player howls after every sip. Forgets: drink 1.

cards.title: The Faerie Queen
cards.rules: She sits on a throne of thorns and judges your manners. Curtsy, then roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Off with your head, briefly. Finish your drink.
Your manners are basic. Drink 4.
You cut down her throne, and she tumbles. Give 5.
Natural 20! You cut down her throne, and she tumbles. Give 10.

jinx.name: Curtsy Court
jinx.rule: The cursed player curtsies before every drink. Forgets: drink 1.

spoils.name: Faerie Scepter
spoils.rules: +2 to elite d20s. +1 to boss d20s.

phases.rules: She demands a toast. Give her one, ten seconds, no ums; the table judges. Fail: drink 3.

cards.title: The Old Bear
cards.rules: A bear older than the forest, woken from a very long nap. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! He sits on you. Drink 8.
He sits on you. Drink 4.
You hand him honey, and he wanders off. Give 5.
Natural 20! He falls back asleep on the spot. Everyone else drinks 3.

phases.rules: He sniffs you for honey. Roll 2d6 to prove you have none.

outcomes.instruction: You have honey on you. Drink 4.
Empty-handed. Give 4.

cards.title: The Green Knight
cards.rules: Twelve feet tall and green as moss. Side bets: thumbs up or down; wrong bets drink 1. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! He takes your head and keeps it a while. Drink 8.
He takes your head, then gives it back. Drink 4.
You land a blow he'll remember. Give 5.
Natural 20! You land a blow he'll remember. Give 10.

phases.rules: His game: you strike, then he does. Arm-wrestle your left neighbor, playing him. Lose: drink 3.

cards.title: The Hungry Wood
cards.rules: The trees close in, and one of them has a mouth. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Swallowed by roots. Drink 8.
Swallowed by roots. Drink 4.
You find the tree with the mouth and kick it. Give 5.
Natural 20! You turn the other trees against it. Everyone else drinks 3.

spoils.name: Wishing Acorns
spoils.rules: Comes with a Lucky Coin and a Healing Potion.

phases.rules: The roots grab for you. Roll d6.

outcomes.instruction: They drag you under. Drink 4.
They grab your foot. Drink 3.
You jump them. Give 3.
You stamp on one. Give 3.
They tangle each other up. Give 4.
You ride a root out. Everyone else drinks 2.

jinx.name: Root-Bound
jinx.rule: The cursed player keeps both feet flat on the floor. Lifts one: drink 1.

cards.title: The Wedding Ghosts
cards.rules: The ghosts of a wedding party from 1498 want one more dance. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! You're in the dance. Drink 8 and tell your worst wedding story.
You're in the dance. Drink 4 and tell your worst wedding story.
You lay them to rest with a song. Give 4.
Natural 20! You lay them to rest with a song. Give 8.

cards.title: The Grudge Wraith
cards.rules: A wraith that remembers every wrong ever done to it, and reads the list aloud. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! It reads the ones you did. Finish your drink.
Your name is on it, twice. Drink 4.
You read it a longer list. Give 4 to whoever holds the oldest grudge.
Natural 20! You read it a longer list. Give 8 to whoever holds the oldest grudge.

cards.title: The Skeleton Butler
cards.rules: A skeleton butler insists on announcing you, and gets your name wrong. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Announced as 'Gary'. Drink 8.
Announced as 'Gary'. Drink 4.
You correct him with dignity. Rename someone; they drink 4.
Natural 20! You correct him with dignity. Rename someone; they drink 8.

cards.title: The Vampire Bat
cards.rules: Staring contest with your right neighbor, who plays the bat. Blink or laugh first: drink 3.

jinx.name: Leeched
jinx.rule: Whenever the cursed player sips, their left neighbor sips too. Neighbor forgets: drink 1.

cards.title: The Fortune Teller
cards.rules: A dead fortune teller reads your palm and your diary. Cross your fingers, then roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Doomed. Drink 6, and confess your last secret.
Doomed. Drink 3, and confess your last secret.
You flip her table. Give 4.
Natural 20! You read her fortune back to her. She vanishes in shame. Give 8.

jinx.name: Ill-Fated
jinx.rule: The cursed player says 'I foresaw this' before every sip. Forgets: drink 1.

cards.title: The Vampire Squire
cards.rules: A young vampire who only drinks from knights. Say 'I'm no knight' twice, then roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! He makes an exception. Drink 8.
He makes an exception. Drink 4.
Garlic to the face. He drops something. Give 3.
Natural 20! Garlic to the face. He drops something. Give 6.

cards.title: The Bone Centipede
cards.rules: Something with a hundred bony legs and no manners. Roll 2d6.

outcomes.instruction: It crawls up your sleeve. Drink 4, and shake it out.
You stomp it flat. Give 4.

dice.doubles: A pair! You stomp it with both feet. Everyone else drinks 2.

cards.title: The Sleepy Mummy
cards.rules: On three, point at who'd sleep three thousand years if nobody woke them. Most fingers: drink 3.

cards.title: The Lich's Scribe
cards.rules: The lich's scribe tests you: your left neighbor asks three trivia questions. Miss two: drink 4.

jinx.name: Question Master
jinx.rule: Anyone who answers a question from the cursed player drinks 1.

cards.title: Tomb of Silence
cards.rules: No laughing in the tomb. The table gets 30 seconds to crack you. Laugh: drink 4.

cards.title: The Bone Tower
cards.rules: Stack the empties into a tower that stands for 5 seconds. Collapse: drink 4.

cards.title: Backwards Chant
cards.rules: Wake the dead: say the alphabet from Z to A in 20 seconds. Stumble: drink 4.

cards.title: The Séance
cards.rules: Hands joined, you summon a spirit. Make someone laugh in 20 seconds, or drink 4.

cards.title: Collapsing Floor
cards.rules: The floor gives way. Last to grab the edge of the table with both hands drinks 2.

cards.title: Dart Wall
cards.rules: Little holes in both walls. Then a click. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Darted, in the backside. Drink 6 standing.
Darted, in the backside. Drink 3 standing.
You limbo under them. Give 2.
Natural 20! You limbo under them. Give 4.

cards.title: Fog of Regret
cards.rules: A green fog that smells like your worst night ever. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Flashbacks. Drink 6.
Flashbacks. Drink 3.
You hold your breath. Give 2 to whoever had the worst night.
Natural 20! You hold your breath. Give 4 to whoever had the worst night.

jinx.name: Flashback
jinx.rule: The cursed player shudders at every drink. Forgets: drink 1.

cards.title: Rolling Skull
cards.rules: A giant stone skull rolls down the corridor. Everyone hums doom music while you roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! It rolls you flat. Drink 6.
It rolls you flat. Drink 3.
You dive into a side tomb. Give 2, and take a bow.
Natural 20! You dive into a side tomb. Give 4, and take a bow.

cards.title: Skeleton Crew
cards.rules: A skeleton crew wants a toast off a femur. Rattle your bones, then roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Off the femur. Drink 6.
Off the femur. Drink 3.
You knock their bones loose. Give 3.
Natural 20! You knock their bones loose. Give 6.

cards.title: The Ghoul Choir
cards.rules: Twelve ghouls singing your name, off key. Hum one note with them, then roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! You join in. Drink 6.
You join in. Drink 3.
You conduct them into a wall. Give 3.
Natural 20! You conduct them into a wall. Give 6.

cards.title: The Zombie Lodger
cards.rules: Light the fuse. Pass a cup clockwise, naming a chore you skipped. The zombie bites whoever holds it.

timer.end: It bites. Whoever is holding the cup drinks 3.

cards.title: The Ghoul Knight
cards.rules: A ghoul knight still guarding a king three hundred years gone. He wants a duel. Roll 2d6.

outcomes.instruction: He drops his sword on you. Drink 4.
You out-fence a corpse. Bow, then give 4.

dice.doubles: You salute the dead king, and he lets you pass. Everyone else bows or drinks 4.

cards.title: Skeleton Minstrels
cards.rules: Three skeletons with lutes. Everyone dances for 10 seconds; the worst dancer drinks 3.

cards.title: Your Own Eulogy
cards.rules: Give your own eulogy in 10 seconds. The table says if it moved them. Not moved: drink 4.

cards.title: The Grabbing Hands
cards.rules: Hands grab from every coffin. Roll four dice.

dice.instruction: Four ankles grabbed. You drink {first}; the next three clockwise drink {second}, {third} and {fourth}.

cards.title: The Ghost Hunters
cards.rules: A band of ghost hunters is sure you're a ghost, and they want proof. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! You do the voice. Drink 6, then moan for them.
You do the voice. Drink 3, then moan for them.
You charge them for the sighting. Give 3.
Natural 20! You charge them for the sighting. Give 6.

cards.title: The Crypt Matron
cards.rules: The crypt's oldest ghost tends the dead like children. She does not like visitors. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! She tucks you into a coffin. Drink 10, then say goodnight.
She tucks you into a coffin. Drink 5, then say goodnight.
You promise to wipe your feet. She packs you something for the road. Give 5.
Natural 20! You promise to wipe your feet. She packs you something for the road. Give 10.

spoils.name: Matron's Basket
spoils.rules: Every heal heals 1 more. Comes with a Healing Potion.

cards.title: Death's Apprentice
cards.rules: Death's apprentice is behind on his quota, and you'll do. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Collected. Drink 10.
Collected. Drink 5.
You fill out his scrolls wrong. He runs, and drops his hourglass. Give 5.
Natural 20! You fill out his scrolls wrong. He runs, and drops his hourglass. Give 10.

cards.title: The Bone Dragon
cards.rules: A dragon skeleton in a tiny hat, guarding a pile of buttons. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! It lies down on you, hat and all. Drink 10.
It lies down on you, hat and all. Drink 5.
You take the hat. It deflates. Give 5.
Natural 20! You take the hat. It deflates. Give 10.

cards.title: The Banshee Bride
cards.rules: She's been at the altar since 1388, and you look just like him. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! She screams your name. Drink 10.
She screams your name. Drink 5.
You object. She vanishes and drops her ring. Give 5.
Natural 20! You object. She vanishes and drops her ring. Give 10.

spoils.name: Widow's Ring
spoils.rules: +2 to boss d20s. Bosses hurt 1 more.

cards.title: The Bone Golem
cards.rules: Every bone in the crypt, stacked into one angry giant. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! It falls on you. Drink 10.
It falls on you. Drink 5.
You knock out its keystone bone. Give 4.
Natural 20! It collapses into a pile. Everyone else drinks 3.

phases.rules: It pulls itself back together, mostly. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! It groans and falls on you. Drink 10.
It groans and falls on you. Drink 5.
The last bone comes loose. Give 4.
Natural 20! The last bone comes loose. Give 8.

cards.title: The Crypt Guardian
cards.rules: Seven feet of armor at a door. Side bets: thumbs up or down; wrong bets drink 1. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! He throws you out of the crypt. Finish your drink.
He throws you down the stairs. Drink 5.
You get past one arm. Give 4.
Natural 20! You get past one arm. Give 8.

jinx.name: No First Names
jinx.rule: Nobody says a first name. Slip: drink 1.

spoils.name: Guardian's Lantern
spoils.rules: +1 to monster, trap and relic d20s.

phases.rules: Arm-wrestle your left neighbor, playing the guardian. Lose: drink 4.

cards.title: The Dancing Dead
cards.rules: A skeleton fiddler plays the dead to their feet. Everyone dances, then you roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! He plays you off your feet. Drink 10.
He plays you off your feet. Drink 5.
You snap a string. Give 4.
Natural 20! You take the fiddle. Everyone else drinks 3.

spoils.name: The Fiddle
spoils.rules: Natural 20 on a 19 or 20. Every heal heals 1 more.

phases.rules: He plays faster. Freestyle four lines about the table, in rhyme. Stop or stall: drink 4.

cards.title: The Lich Lord
cards.rules: His soul is in a jeweled cup. Side bets: thumbs up or down; wrong bets drink 1. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! You drink his soul. Finish your drink.
His soul is very strong. Drink 5.
You smash the cup. Give 4.
Natural 20! You smash the cup. Give 8.

spoils.name: Phylactery
spoils.rules: −1 max heart. Comes with a Phoenix Feather.

spoils.name: Lich's Crown
spoils.rules: +1 to boss d20s. Natural 20 on a 19 or 20.

phases.rules: He pours his soul into a second cup. Roll d6.

outcomes.instruction: You drink the wrong one. Drink 5.
You drink both. Drink 4.
He drinks yours. Drink 3.
You smash one. Give 3.
You smash both. Give 4.
You make him drink his own soul. Everyone else drinks 2.

jinx.name: Undead
jinx.rule: The cursed player groans like a zombie before every sip. Forgets: drink 1.

cards.title: The Crypt Keeper
cards.rules: Every soul down here owes him a coin, and so do you. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! He collects from you. Drink 10.
He collects from you. Drink 5.
You pay the last toll, and the dead rest. Give 4.
Natural 20! You buy the whole crypt. Everyone else drinks 3.

spoils.name: Grave Goods
spoils.rules: Comes with a Lucky Coin and a Tower Shield.

phases.rules: Name five things buried with a king, in ten seconds. Fall short: drink 4.

jinx.name: Last Rites
jinx.rule: The cursed player says 'rest in peace' whenever a card is put aside. Misses one: drink 1.

cards.title: Goblin Sappers
cards.rules: Three goblins with a barrel of blasting powder and one match. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Boom. Drink 8, and do the explosion with your hands.
Boom. Drink 4, and do the explosion with your hands.
You blow out the match. Give 4.
Natural 20! You blow out the match. Give 8.

cards.title: The Mimic Cart
cards.rules: On three, point at who'd climb into a mine cart that licks its lips. Most fingers: drink 3.

cards.title: The Goblin Miner
cards.rules: A goblin in a lamp-helmet who loves it down here. Loves it. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! He hugs you, helmet and all. Drink 8.
He hugs you, helmet and all. Drink 4.
You blow out his lamp. He leaves something smoky behind. Give 3.
Natural 20! You blow out his lamp. He leaves something smoky behind. Give 6.

cards.title: The Rock Troll
cards.rules: A rock troll wants a flex-off. Everyone flexes; the table picks the weakest flex. They drink 3.

cards.title: The Hungry Goblin
cards.rules: Bread-off: you and your left neighbor mime eating a loaf. Slower, by the table's call: drink 4.

cards.title: The Goblin Alchemist
cards.rules: She brews in the mine's runoff and offers you a sip. Hold your nose, then roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! You sip, and ask for seconds. Drink 6 and say it was lovely.
You sip. Drink 3 and say it tasted fine.
You pour it back. Give 4.
Natural 20! You pour it back. Give 8.

jinx.name: Fumes
jinx.rule: The cursed player can only whisper. Too loud: drink 1.

cards.title: Ooze Pup
cards.rules: A baby ooze made of mine slime. It wants its mother. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! It clings. Drink 6.
It clings. Drink 3.
You scrape it off. Give 4, and make the noise.
Natural 20! You scrape it off. Give 8, and make the noise.

jinx.name: Slimy Fingers
jinx.rule: The cursed player holds their drink with two fingers only. Caught: drink 1.

cards.title: The Four-Armed Ogre
cards.rules: The four-armed ogre arm-wrestles the table, clockwise. Roll four dice.

dice.instruction: Four arms pinned. You drink {first}; the next three clockwise drink {second}, {third} and {fourth}.

cards.title: The Old Dwarf
cards.rules: A dwarf who trained four heroes and got nothing for it. He wants a fight. Roll d6.

outcomes.instruction: Hammered. Drink 4.
He lectures you on gratitude. Drink 4.
You bow first. He respects it. Give 3.
You flip him over his anvil. Give 4.
You thank him. He cries. Give 4.
You do a perfect axe spin. Everyone else drinks 2.

cards.title: The Echo Cave
cards.rules: Your right neighbor echoes everything you say for 20 seconds. You laugh first: drink 4.

jinx.name: Bat Signal
jinx.rule: Whenever the cursed player points at the ceiling, the last to copy drinks 1.

cards.title: Troll Stench
cards.rules: Hold your nose and describe your day for 30 seconds. Let go: drink 4.

cards.title: The Crawlspace
cards.rules: Crawl under the table and out the other side without touching a leg. Touch one: drink 4.

cards.title: Spell the Mine
cards.rules: Say a word starting with each letter of GOBLIN, in order, in 10 seconds. Stumble: drink 4.

cards.title: Mine Cart Race
cards.rules: Race your left neighbor: take a sip, then say 'cart' three times. Slower: drink 4.

cards.title: The Powder Keg
cards.rules: Light the fuse. Pass a cup clockwise, naming a gemstone. The keg blows on whoever holds it.

timer.end: Boom. Whoever is holding the cup drinks 3.

cards.title: The Loose Rail
cards.rules: The rail under your foot isn't attached to anything. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! One leg down a shaft. Drink 6 on one leg.
One leg down a shaft. Drink 3 on one leg.
You hop off. Give 2.
Natural 20! You hop off. Give 4.

cards.title: Fire Damp
cards.rules: Somebody lit a torch. Down here. In the gas. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Whoomph. Drink 6, and pat out your hair.
Whoomph. Drink 3, and pat out your hair.
You dive into a puddle. Give 2 to whoever you blame.
Natural 20! You dive into a puddle. Give 4 to whoever you blame.

cards.title: The Ore Chute
cards.rules: The floor tilts into an ore chute. Lean back in your chair, then roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Down the chute, face first. Drink 6.
Down the chute, face first. Drink 3.
You surf it. Give 2 to the worst surfer here.
Natural 20! You surf it. Give 4 to the worst surfer here.

cards.title: The Kobold Conga
cards.rules: The kobolds are doing a conga line, and now you're in it. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! You conga'd. Drink 6, and lead a conga to the door.
You conga'd. Drink 3, and lead a conga to the door.
You break the line. Give 3.
Natural 20! You break the line. Give 6.

cards.title: The Goblin Gang
cards.rules: Three goblins in stolen armor, one with a very small dagger. Snap your fingers, then roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! They take your purse. Drink 6.
They take your purse. Drink 3.
You out-cool them. Give 3.
Natural 20! You out-cool them. Give 6.

cards.title: The Goblin Boss
cards.rules: A goblin in a big hat says that's a nice drink. Shame if something happened to it. Roll 2d6.

outcomes.instruction: Something happens to it. Drink 4.
You make him an offer. Pick someone to kiss your ring or drink 4.

dice.doubles: He makes you the boss. Everyone else kisses your ring or drinks 4.

cards.title: The Tunnel Spider
cards.rules: Eight legs out of eight tunnels, reaching for drinks. Roll four dice.

dice.instruction: It steals from four glasses. You drink {first}; the next three clockwise drink {second}, {third} and {fourth}.

cards.title: Hold Your Breath
cards.rules: Hold your breath for 20 seconds while the table describes troll breath. Gasp early: drink 4.

cards.title: Falling Rocks
cards.rules: A rock is working itself loose from the ceiling right above you. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! It lands on your foot. Drink 6.
It lands on your foot. Drink 3.
You catch it like a ball. Throw a coaster to someone; they drink 3.
Natural 20! You catch it like a ball. Throw a coaster to someone; they drink 6.

cards.title: Rookie Adventurers
cards.rules: Four rookie adventurers are sure you're the monster at the end of their quest. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! A wooden sword to the face. Drink 6, then growl.
A wooden sword to the face. Drink 3, then growl.
You surrender, and they leave happy. Give 3.
Natural 20! You surrender, and they leave happy. Give 6.

cards.title: The Ore Golem
cards.rules: Every bit of ore the goblins ever dropped, fused into one angry golem. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! It falls on you. Drink 10.
It falls on you. Drink 5.
You knock out its core. Inside: something shiny. Don't ask. Give 5.
Natural 20! You knock out its core. Inside: something shiny. Don't ask. Give 10.

spoils.name: Golden Pick
spoils.rules: +2 to ambush d20s. +1 to boss d20s.

cards.title: The Kobold Captain
cards.rules: A kobold in a captain's hat with a tiny cutlass and a big grudge. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Keelhauled, somehow, underground. Drink 10, and say 'aye aye, captain'.
Keelhauled, somehow, underground. Drink 5, and say 'aye aye, captain'.
You take his hat and his cart. Give 5.
Natural 20! You take his hat and his cart. Give 10.

spoils.name: Captain's Hat
spoils.rules: +1 satchel slot. Comes with a Lucky Coin.

cards.title: The Goblin Kingpin
cards.rules: He runs every tunnel from here to the river, and he's heard about you. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! You owe him now. Drink 10.
You owe him now. Drink 5.
You flip him. He works for you now. Give 5.
Natural 20! You flip him. He works for you now. Give 10.

spoils.name: Kingpin's Ledger
spoils.rules: +1 satchel slot. Comes with a Smoke Bomb and a Healing Potion.

cards.title: The Deep Siren
cards.rules: She sings from the flooded shaft, and every miner follows. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! You follow. Drink 10, and hum her song.
You follow. Drink 5, and hum her song.
You cover your ears and sing louder. Give 5.
Natural 20! You cover your ears and sing louder. Give 10.

spoils.name: Siren Song
spoils.rules: +2 to elite d20s. +1 to boss d20s.

cards.title: The Goblin King
cards.rules: A goblin king on a throne of pans. Side bets: thumbs up or down; wrong bets drink 1. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! He has you pelted with spoons. Drink 10.
He has you pelted with spoons. Drink 5.
You knock over his throne. Give 4.
Natural 20! You steal his crown. Everyone else drinks 3.

phases.rules: His goblins rush back in. Roll 2d6.

outcomes.instruction: They pile on you. Drink 5.
You scatter them. Give 4.

jinx.name: The Royal We
jinx.rule: The cursed player can't say 'I' or 'me'. Slip: drink 1.

cards.title: The Ogre Foreman
cards.rules: An ogre with a whip and a quota. Side bets: thumbs up or down; wrong bets drink 1. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! He doesn't like your face. Drink 10.
He doesn't like your face. Drink 5.
You bowl him over with a mine cart. Give 4.
Natural 20! He falls down a shaft. Everyone else drinks 3.

phases.rules: He wants your miner's stance. Hold it on one leg while the table counts to 15. Wobble: drink 4.

cards.title: The Mine Lord
cards.rules: A dwarf lord crowned in gold, mad with greed, sure you're a thief. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! He crowns you, and now you're mad too. Finish your drink.
He hits you with a gold bar. Drink 5.
You snap his scepter. Give 4.
Natural 20! You snap his scepter. Give 8.

jinx.name: No Pointing
jinx.rule: Nobody points at anything. Slip: drink 1.

spoils.name: Mine Lord's Shield
spoils.rules: Traps hurt 1 less. Comes with a Tower Shield.

phases.rules: Kneel and swear fealty to the Mine Lord, in one breath, in rhyme. Stumble: drink 4.

cards.title: Mother of Goblins
cards.rules: The goblins' mother has heard what you did to her boys. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! She adopts you. Finish your drink, then call her mom.
She sits on you, gently, for an hour. Drink 5.
You apologize to her face. She weeps. Give 4.
Natural 20! You apologize to her face. She weeps. Give 8.

spoils.name: Mother's Lullaby
spoils.rules: Every heal heals 1 more. Comes with a Healing Potion.

phases.rules: She wants an apology. Apologize to your left neighbor for 15 seconds, sincerely. Laugh: drink 4.

cards.title: The Rock Worm
cards.rules: Eighty years in the tunnels, and now it's as long as the mountain. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! It wraps around you twice. Drink 10.
It wraps around you twice. Drink 5.
You tie it in a knot. Give 4.
Natural 20! You tie it in a bow. Everyone else drinks 3.

phases.rules: It comes up through the floor behind you. Roll d6.

outcomes.instruction: It swallows your arm. Drink 5.
It swallows your drink. Drink 4.
It hisses. Drink 3.
You block the hole. Give 3.
You spear it. Give 4.
You tie it to a beam. Everyone else drinks 2.

jinx.name: Cave-In
jinx.rule: Nobody talks to the cursed player, and they talk to nobody. Slip: drink 1.

cards.title: The Thirsty Kraken
cards.rules: The kraken sips from four glasses at once. Roll four dice.

dice.instruction: Four glasses, four sips. You drink {first}; the next three clockwise drink {second}, {third} and {fourth}.

cards.title: The Singing Rock
cards.rules: A siren on a rock sings 'one more drink', and it's beautiful. Cover your ears, then roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! You swim to her. Finish your drink.
You swim to her. Finish half your drink.
You stuff your ears with seaweed. Give 5.
Natural 20! You stuff your ears with seaweed. Give 10.

cards.title: The Old Sailor
cards.rules: Read alone his one story, start the clock, then tell it as him. The table guesses what it's about.
cards.secret: THE ONE THAT GOT AWAY (A FISH).

timer.end: Time. Someone guessed it? Give 3. Nobody did? Drink 3.

cards.title: The Foam Giant
cards.rules: A wave of sea foam the size of a ship rises out of the bay. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! It washes over you. Drink 10, and wear the mustache.
It washes over you. Drink 5, and wear the mustache.
You blow the top off it. Give 5.
Natural 20! You blow the top off it. Give 10.

cards.title: The Piranha Pool
cards.rules: Piranhas in the tide pool. On three, everyone points at who'd swim anyway. Most fingers: drink 3.

cards.title: The Merfolk Herald
cards.rules: A merfolk herald wants your deeds. Out-brag your left neighbor for 15 seconds. Loser: drink 4.

jinx.name: Fish Out of Water
jinx.rule: The cursed player gasps like a fish after every sip. Forgets: drink 1.

cards.title: The Whispering Eel
cards.rules: An eel whispers: write them a letter. Sit on your hands, then roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! You write it. Drink 8, then tell the table what it said.
You write it. Drink 4, then tell the table what it said.
You bite the eel first. Give 5.
Natural 20! You send the eel instead. It never writes back. Give 10.

jinx.name: My Dearest
jinx.rule: The cursed player starts every sentence with 'My dearest'. Forgets: drink 1.

cards.title: The Mimic Barrel
cards.rules: The barrel is a mimic. Pour-off with your right neighbor: mime a pint. Table's worse pour: drink 5.

cards.title: The Pirate Ghost
cards.rules: A drowned pirate wants his rum back. Say 'arr' like you mean it, then roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! He takes it in blood. Drink 10.
He takes it in blood. Drink 5.
You hand him a bottle of grog. He's confused, then grateful. Give 5.
Natural 20! You hand him a bottle of grog. He's confused, then grateful. Give 10.

jinx.name: Pirate Tongue
jinx.rule: The cursed player ends every sentence with 'arr'. Forgets: drink 1.

cards.title: The Drowned Choir
cards.rules: Hum a song until the table names it. 20 seconds. Nobody gets it: drink 5.

cards.title: Rising Tide
cards.rules: The tide's at your chin. Hold your breath for 30 seconds. Breathe early: drink 5.

cards.title: The Ship's Cook
cards.rules: Feed the crew: name everyone's drink from memory. Miss one: drink 5.

cards.title: Sea Shanty
cards.rules: Lead the table in a sea shanty. If nobody joins in by the second line, drink 5.

cards.title: Rip Current
cards.rules: The shallows turn into a river. Swim with your arms, then roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Swept away. Drink 8.
Swept away. Drink 4.
You ride it out. Give 3 to whoever's drowning in their drink.
Natural 20! You ride it out. Give 6 to whoever's drowning in their drink.

cards.title: Barnacle Rock
cards.rules: You sat on a rock. Now you can't stand up. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Fused to it. Drink 8, and stay seated until your next turn.
Fused to it. Drink 4, and stay seated until your next turn.
You rip free, mostly. Give 3.
Natural 20! You rip free, mostly. Give 6.

cards.title: The Undertow
cards.rules: You wade in for a shell, and the sea pulls you under. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Swallowed. Drink 8, holding your breath first.
Swallowed. Drink 4, holding your breath first.
You kick off a rock. Give 3.
Natural 20! You kick off a rock. Give 6.

cards.title: The Whirlpool
cards.rules: A whirlpool opens in the bay. Last to spin once in their seat drinks 3.

cards.title: The Shock Eels
cards.rules: Two eels circle your boots, sparking. They are not here to talk. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Zapped, twice. Drink 8.
Zapped, twice. Drink 4.
You tie them in a knot. Give 4.
Natural 20! You tie them in a knot. Give 8.

cards.title: The Merfolk Wedding
cards.rules: A merfolk wedding, out of wine, and you're the nearest guests. Toast the bride, then roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! They take yours. Drink 8.
They take yours. Drink 4.
You find them wine. They cry. Give 4.
Natural 20! You find them wine. They cry. Give 8.

cards.title: The Kelp Guard
cards.rules: Living kelp asks who looks least like a fish. On three, everyone points. Most fingers: drink 3.

cards.title: The Barnacled Knight
cards.rules: A knight so covered in barnacles he's mostly reef. He wants to arm-wrestle. Roll 2d6.

outcomes.instruction: Reefed. Drink 5.
You scrape him off the rock. Arm-wrestle anyone; the loser drinks 5.

dice.doubles: He's actually lovely. Everyone else drinks 5 to the knight.

cards.title: Jellyfish Bloom
cards.rules: A bloom of glowing jellyfish drifts past. Grab one. Roll d6.

outcomes.instruction: Stung. Drink 5.
Stung twice. Drink 5.
That one was angry. Drink 5.
It tastes like lime. Give 4.
It glows in your hand. Give 4.
You catch the whole bloom. Everyone else drinks 2.

cards.title: Bail Out
cards.rules: Mime bailing water out of the boat for 20 seconds without laughing. Laugh: drink 5.

cards.title: Floating Wreckage
cards.rules: Wreckage in the shallows, and a barrel is drifting at your knees. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! It takes your legs out. Drink 8.
It takes your legs out. Drink 4.
You ride it like a surfboard. Pick someone to stand; they drink 3.
Natural 20! You ride it like a surfboard. Pick someone to stand; they drink 6.

cards.title: The Lost Fishermen
cards.rules: Six fishermen, lost at sea since Tuesday, still casting. Cast an imaginary line, then roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Hooked by the ear. Drink 8.
Hooked by the ear. Drink 4.
You point them at the horizon. Give 4.
Natural 20! You point them at the horizon. Give 8.

cards.title: The Sea Hag
cards.rules: She's been owed since the flood, and she's collecting from you. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Collected. Drink 12.
Collected. Drink 6.
She pays you in pearls. Hand out 6 like they're pearls.
Natural 20! She pays you in pearls. Hand out 12 like they're pearls.

spoils.name: Sea Hag's Pearl
spoils.rules: +1 max heart. Every heal heals 1 more.

spoils.name: Hag's Due
spoils.rules: +1 to boss d20s. Comes with a Lucky Coin.

cards.title: The Shark Knight
cards.rules: A shark in armor, sharpening his sword on his teeth, is cutting someone down. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! It's you. Drink 12.
It's you. Drink 6.
You punch it on the nose. Give 6 to whoever should be cut off.
Natural 20! You punch it on the nose. Give 12 to whoever should be cut off.

cards.title: The Deep One
cards.rules: Something under the bay has drunk every wreck's wine for a century. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! It drinks you a bit. Drink 12.
It drinks you a bit. Drink 6.
You pour it a cup. It sinks back, happy. Give 6.
Natural 20! You pour it a cup. It sinks back, happy. Give 12.

spoils.name: The Deep Cup
spoils.rules: Every heal heals 1 more. Ambushes hurt 1 less.

cards.title: The Lighthouse Keeper
cards.rules: He hasn't seen a soul in forty years, and he's not letting you leave. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! He tells you about the forty years. Drink 12 while someone tells you about theirs.
He tells you about the forty years. Drink 6 while someone tells you about theirs.
You fix his light, and he lets you go. Give 6.
Natural 20! You fix his light, and he lets you go. Give 12.

cards.title: The Lava Spout
cards.rules: Light the fuse. Pass a cup clockwise, naming something hot. The lava spits on whoever holds it.

timer.end: The lava spits. Whoever is holding the cup drinks 3.

cards.title: The Forge Golem
cards.rules: Your left neighbor names three weapons for the forge. Repeat them back in order. Miss one: drink 5.

jinx.name: Hammer Time
jinx.rule: Whenever the cursed player yells 'Hammer!', the last to raise both hands drinks 1.

cards.title: The Living Magma
cards.rules: A blob of magma that has been fed for a thousand years. It wants more. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! It rises over you. Drink 10.
It rises over you. Drink 5.
You cool it with a bucket. Give 5 to whoever runs hottest.

cards.title: The Imp Foreman
cards.rules: The imp foreman is screaming for hands, and you have hands. Roll d6.

outcomes.instruction: Coal everywhere. Drink 5.
You drop the king's sword in the lava. Drink 5.
You burn your palm on the anvil. Drink 5.
Done. Give 4.
Done, hot and fast. Give 5.
You carry six buckets at once. Everyone else drinks 2.

cards.title: The Fire Judge
cards.rules: A demon judge who weighs every hero's soul, and yours is light. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Found wanting. Drink 10, and list your sins out loud.
Found wanting. Drink 5, and list your sins out loud.
You impress him. He tips you his flask. Give 4.
Natural 20! You impress him. He tips you his flask. Give 8.

cards.title: The Salamander
cards.rules: On three, everyone points at who'd pet a salamander that's on fire. Most fingers: drink 3.

cards.rules: A swarm of sparks drifts over the table. Roll four dice.

dice.instruction: Four seats, four burns. You drink {first}; the next three clockwise drink {second}, {third} and {fourth}.

cards.title: The Screaming Smith
cards.rules: A ghost blacksmith who screams at every blade he sees. Yours is next. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! He calls you useless, at length. Drink 10.
He calls you useless, at length. Drink 5.
You hand him something perfect. He goes quiet. Give 5.
Natural 20! You hand him something perfect. He goes quiet. Give 10.

jinx.name: Apprentice
jinx.rule: The cursed player answers only to 'apprentice'. Answers to their name: drink 1.

cards.title: The Roasting Boar
cards.rules: A fire boar, smoking, and it has decided you are dinner. Roll 2d6.

outcomes.instruction: Basted. Drink 5.
You carve your way out. Carve someone a slice; they drink 5.

dice.doubles: A feast for everyone. Everyone else drinks 5 with a mouthful.

cards.title: The Forge Oath
cards.rules: The forge demands an oath. For 30 seconds, answer everything with 'By the flame!' Miss one: drink 5.

cards.title: The Bucket Line
cards.rules: The cave is burning. Carry four empties on one arm across the room and back. Drop one: drink 5.

cards.title: Fire Names
cards.rules: Name ten fiery things, real or made up, in 20 seconds. Stumble: drink 5.

cards.title: The Fire Ritual
cards.rules: Pitch the table a new fire ritual in 20 seconds. Fewer than half would join in: drink 5.

cards.title: Burst of Flame
cards.rules: A gas vent catches. Everyone yells 'FIRE!', then you roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Singed. Drink 8.
Singed. Drink 4.
You smother it with a shield. Give 3 to whoever looks hot.
Natural 20! You smother it with a shield. Give 6 to whoever looks hot.

cards.title: Obsidian Glass
cards.rules: The floor here is glass-smooth obsidian. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Down. Drink 8, and lie on the floor for 5 seconds.
Down. Drink 4, and lie on the floor for 5 seconds.
You skate it. Give 3.
Natural 20! You skate it. Give 6.

cards.title: The Furnace Door
cards.rules: The furnace door bursts open. Everyone shouts 'Duck!'; the last to shout drinks 3.

cards.title: The Blade Trap
cards.rules: Blades swing out of the walls on their own. Hands up, then roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Thinly sliced. Drink 8.
Thinly sliced. Drink 4.
You jam the blades. Slice the table in half; the other half drinks 3.
Natural 20! You jam the blades. Slice the table in half; the other half drinks 6.

cards.title: Fire Imps
cards.rules: Two fire imps are stealing your rations. Hide your hands, then roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! They take your bread too. Drink 8.
They take your bread too. Drink 4.
You chase them out. Give 4.
Natural 20! You chase them out. Give 8.

cards.title: The Fire Cult
cards.rules: A fire cult in red robes insists you join the dancing. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! You dance. Drink 8.
You dance. Drink 4.
You tell them it's the wrong solstice. Their minds break. Give 4.
Natural 20! You tell them it's the wrong solstice. Their minds break. Give 8.

cards.title: The Sulfur Ghost
cards.rules: The ghost of every rotten egg ever cracked. Hold your nose, then roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! You were the rotten egg all along. Drink 10 and apologize.
You smell like it now. Drink 5.
You open a vent. Give 5 to whoever smells eggiest.
Natural 20! You open a vent. Give 10 to whoever smells eggiest.

cards.rules: Read alone what the imp is roasting, start the clock, then describe it like a bard. Table guesses.

timer.end: Time. Someone guessed it? Give 3. Nobody did? Drink 3.

cards.rules: The forge bell won't stop: two hundred swords, all for you. Roll 2d6.

outcomes.instruction: You're buried in orders. Drink 5.
Heard. Shout 'Heard!' and give 5.

dice.doubles: A pair! You melt them all into one. Everyone else drinks 2.

cards.title: The Smith's Wares
cards.rules: Sell the smith's wares: make up three magic swords, with prices, in 15 seconds. Stall: drink 5.

cards.rules: Light the fuse. Pass a cup clockwise, saying 'hot, hot, hot'. It burns whoever holds it.

timer.end: Too hot. Whoever is holding the cup drinks 3.

cards.rules: Two bandits are robbing the forge. Shout your battle cry, then roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! They sell you your own sword. Drink 8.
They sell you your own sword. Drink 4.
You chase them off with a ladle. Give 4.
Natural 20! You chase them off with a ladle. Give 8.

cards.rules: He's thrown a boulder at everyone tonight. You're next. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! The boulder. Drink 12.
The boulder. Drink 6.
You bow low. He's moved, and hands you his lucky blade. Give 6.
Natural 20! You bow low. He's moved, and hands you his lucky blade. Give 12.

cards.rules: The orc butcher is sharpening, and sharpening, and sharpening. Roll d20.

Filleted. Drink 6.
You take his apron. It's basically armor. Give 6.
Natural 20! You take his apron. It's basically armor. Give 12.

spoils.name: Phoenix Talon
spoils.rules: +1 to monster, elite and ambush d20s.

cards.secret: A FROG THAT OWES HIM MONEY.

timer.end: Time. Someone guessed it? Give 3. Nobody did? Drink 3.

You put him back in his pond. Give 3.

cards.rules: Thumb war with your left neighbor, who plays the mud golem. Best of three. Lose: drink 3.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! You tell it the truth. Drink 6.
You tell it the truth. Drink 3.

Natural 20! You call it radiant, and it finally lies back down. Give 6.

cards.rules: Leeches in the water, and they've found the table. Roll four dice.

dice.instruction: They latch onto four seats. You drink {first}; the next three clockwise drink {second}, {third} and {fourth}.

cards.title: The Bog Hag
cards.rules: She lives in a hut on chicken legs and hates visitors. Make your ugliest face, then roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Your face stays like that. Drink 6 while the table watches.
She makes it uglier. Drink 3.
She's charmed, and lets you by. Give 3.
Natural 20! She's charmed, and lets you by. Give 6.

jinx.name: Hag-Ridden
jinx.rule: The cursed player cackles before every sip. Forgets: drink 1.

outcomes.instruction: Bitten. Drink 3.
You disarm him. Karate-chop the air, then give 2.

dice.doubles: You become the lizard. Everyone else drinks 3, silently.

cards.rules: A giant crab guards the boardwalk. Flick a coaster to the far edge, two tries. Miss: drink 3.

cards.rules: A toad auctions a jar of glowing swamp water. Bid sips clockwise; top bid drinks them.

Seeds everywhere. Drink 2.
You dive behind a log. Give 2 to whoever got splashed.
Natural 20! You dive behind a log. Give 4 to whoever got splashed.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Into the water. Drink 4.
Into the water. Drink 2.
You surf it out. Give 2 to whoever would have panicked.
Natural 20! You surf it out. Give 4 to whoever would have panicked.

Natural 20! You moonwalk across. Moonwalk to your seat, then give 4.

You're in the choir now. Drink 2.
You out-croak them. Give 2.
Natural 20! You out-croak them. Give 4.

Hush money. Drink 2.

You dodge. Give 2.

He sits on you. Drink 4.
You knock his crown into the bog. Give 5.

He complains until you drown. Drink 4.

Squeezed. Drink 4.

You slip loose. Give 4.

It reads a curse at you. Drink 4.
You slam it shut. Shush someone; they drink 4.
Natural 20! You read it back to itself, and it falls asleep. Give 8.

You pull him free. Pick his new master; they drink 4.
Natural 20! You pull him free. Pick his new master; they drink 8.

cards.rules: Nine feet of clay guarding the stair, and it wants the password. Guess one aloud, then roll d20.

It squeezes you into a new shape. Drink 4.
You smudge the word on its forehead. It sits down. Give 4.
Natural 20! You smudge the word on its forehead. It sits down. Give 8.

You knock its helmet off. Clank at someone; they drink 4.
Natural 20! You knock its helmet off. Clank at someone; they drink 8.

Natural 20! You pull its cork. It's defenseless. Give 6.

Flat on your back. Drink 3.

Natural 20! You triple-axel it. The table scores you; give 6.

Natural 20! You step aside, and it slams shut. Give 6.

It drops you down a floor. Drink 5.
You find its heart-stone and pry it loose. Give 5.
Natural 20! You kick the front door off. Everyone else drinks 3.

phases.rules: The light's out. Eyes shut, touch the nose of your left neighbor on the first try. Miss: drink 4.

cards.title: The Mad Alchemist
cards.rules: He brews only exploding potions, and he never stops pouring. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! You ask for seconds. Finish your drink.
Straight to the brain. Drink 5.
You ask for it neat. He weeps. Give 5.
Natural 20! You ask for it neat. He weeps. Give 10.

spoils.name: Bubbling Flask
spoils.rules: Comes with a Healing Potion and a Hired Sword.

phases.rules: He serves the house special. Roll 2d6.

outcomes.instruction: It explodes. Drink 5.
You sip it slowly, like an adult. Give 5.

dice.doubles: You hand it back, and it explodes on him. Give 7.

jinx.name: Bubbles
jinx.rule: The cursed player ends every sentence with 'bloop'. Forgets: drink 1.

cards.title: The Archmage
cards.rules: The oldest wizard alive. He doesn't move, and nothing near him does either. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! You stop moving. Drink 10.
You stop moving. Drink 5.
You sneeze, and break his focus. Give 5.
Natural 20! You set his beard on fire. Everyone else drinks 3.

jinx.name: Countdown
jinx.rule: The cursed player counts down from three, out loud, before every sip. Forgets: drink 1.

phases.rules: He casts a holding spell. Freeze while the table counts to 15. Move, laugh or blink: drink 4.

cards.title: The Puppet Master
cards.rules: A wizard with strings on every finger. Side bets: thumbs up or down; wrong bets drink 1. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! You become a puppet. Finish your drink.
You dance for him. Drink 5.
You cut a string. He can't cope. Give 5.
Natural 20! You cut a string. He can't cope. Give 10.

phases.rules: He makes the table dance. Name six dances in ten seconds. Fall short: drink 4.

cards.title: The Frozen Apprentice
cards.rules: The wizard's last apprentice, frozen mid-spell a hundred years ago, now thawing. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! He finishes the spell, on you. Drink 10.
He finishes the spell, on you. Drink 5.
You tell him the wizard retired. He shatters. Give 5.
Natural 20! He thanks you and melts, politely. Everyone else drinks 3.

spoils.name: Thawed Heart
spoils.rules: +1 max heart. Every heal heals 1 more.

phases.rules: He asks what he missed. Name three new things in ten seconds. Fall short: drink 4.

jinx.name: As I Was Saying
jinx.rule: The cursed player starts every sentence with 'As I was saying'. Forgets: drink 1.

cards.title: The Eagle King
cards.rules: Screech-off with your left neighbor; the table picks the better eagle. Worse eagle: drink 5.

cards.title: The Mountain Horn
cards.rules: A giant on the peak blows a horn, and he takes requests personally. Roll d6.

outcomes.instruction: He blows your name into the echo. Drink 5.
He plays your ex's song. Drink 5.
The horn, right in your ear. Drink 5.
You request a war song. Give 4.
You plug the horn with snow. Give 5.
You take the horn. Everyone else drinks 2.

cards.title: The Wind
cards.rules: Not a monster. Just the wind, a mile up, and it wants your drink. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! It takes your hat and your dignity. Drink 10.
It takes your hat and your dignity. Drink 5.
You lean into it like a hero on a cliff. Hair flip, then give 5.
Natural 20! You lean into it like a hero on a cliff. Hair flip, then give 10.

jinx.name: Windswept
jinx.rule: The cursed player flips their hair before speaking. Forgets: drink 1.

cards.title: The Snow Owl
cards.rules: A snow owl eyes the table. Last to cover their drink with a hand drinks 3.

cards.title: The Ice Golem
cards.rules: A golem of ice blocks needs one more snowman, and you're the head. Roll 2d6.

outcomes.instruction: Packed into a snowman. Drink 5.
You knock its head off. Give 5 to whoever's posing.

dice.doubles: It builds you a throne instead. Everyone else drinks 5.

cards.title: The Hermit
cards.rules: A hermit on the next ledge threatens to start an avalanche. Wave at him, then roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! He shouts, and it's your mom. Drink 10, and wave again.
He shouts. Drink 5.
You invite him over. Pick someone to be the hermit; they drink 5.
Natural 20! You invite him over. Pick someone to be the hermit; they drink 10.

jinx.name: Avalanche Rules
jinx.rule: The cursed player may only whisper. Speak up: drink 1.

cards.title: The Ice Troll
cards.rules: An ice troll on the ledge, pretending to be a rock. Everyone freezes while you roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! It drops on you. Drink 10.
It drops on you. Drink 5.
You push it off the ledge. Give 5 to whoever's still as stone.
Natural 20! You push it off the ledge. Give 10 to whoever's still as stone.

jinx.name: Stone Still
jinx.rule: The cursed player sits perfectly still while anyone else rolls. Moves: drink 1.

cards.title: The Blizzard
cards.rules: The sky opens, and nobody brought a cloak. Roll 2d6.

outcomes.instruction: Frozen to the bone. Drink 5.
You dance in it. Everyone dances or drinks 5.

dice.doubles: A pair! Thundersnow strikes your cup and warms it. Everyone else drinks 3.

cards.title: The Snow Fox
cards.rules: Guarding the rations: rock-paper-scissors with your right neighbor, best of 3. Lose: drink 5.

cards.title: To the Mountain
cards.rules: Give a toast to the mountain in 15 seconds, no 'um'. Say 'um': drink 5.

cards.title: Mountain Names
cards.rules: Name five famous mountains in 10 seconds. Stumble: drink 5.

cards.title: The Slow Dance
cards.rules: Slow dance with your right neighbor for 10 seconds, eyes locked, to keep warm. Laugh: drink 5.

cards.title: The Summit Pose
cards.rules: Give the table your best heroic summit pose. The table votes it fake: drink 5.

cards.title: The Ledge
cards.rules: You lean over for the view, and the ice leans with you. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! You see your life flash. Drink 8.
You see your life flash. Drink 4.
You step back, cool. Give 4 to whoever gasped.
Natural 20! You step back, cool. Give 8 to whoever gasped.

cards.title: Snow Slide
cards.rules: Snow slides off the cliff above. Last to cover their head with both hands drinks 3.

cards.title: The Ice Bridge
cards.rules: The ice bridge cracks right under your foot. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! You slide. Drink 8.
You slide. Drink 4.
You land it like a mountain goat. Shout 'goat!' and give 4.
Natural 20! You land it like a mountain goat. Shout 'goat!' and give 8.

cards.title: The Campfire Hog
cards.rules: On three, everyone points at who'd hog the campfire. Most fingers: drink 3.

cards.title: The Mountain Monks
cards.rules: Twenty monks meditating on the pass, and you're in their way. Bow, then roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! They make you join. Drink 8.
They make you join. Drink 4.
You bow out. Give 4.
Natural 20! You bow out. Give 8.

cards.title: The Griffin Flight
cards.rules: Twelve griffins in a V, on a strafing run. Duck, then roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Direct hit. Drink 8.
Direct hit. Drink 4.
You duck behind a rock. Give 4.
Natural 20! You duck behind a rock. Give 8.

cards.title: The Snowball Imp
cards.rules: A snowball imp pelts the table. Roll four dice.

dice.instruction: It hits four bad sides. You drink {first}; the next three clockwise drink {second}, {third} and {fourth}.

cards.title: The Hot Spring Wizard
cards.rules: A 'wizard' in a hot spring wants your drink. Hold it close, then roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! He's a wizard. Drink 10.
He's a wizard. Drink 5.
He's just an old man. Give 5 to whoever believed him.
Natural 20! He is a wizard, and he likes you. Give 10, and he makes it snow.

cards.title: The Avalanche
cards.rules: Light the fuse. Pass a cup clockwise, each 'shh' quieter. The avalanche hits whoever holds it.

timer.end: RUMBLE. Whoever is holding the cup drinks 3.

cards.title: The Heckling Yeti
cards.rules: A yeti on the next peak heckles you. Roast him back in 10 seconds. Weak roast: drink 5.

cards.title: The Snow Shelf
cards.rules: The snow shelf above you is sagging. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Buried. Drink 8.
Buried. Drink 4.
You poke it from a safe distance. Point at someone; they drink 3.
Natural 20! You poke it from a safe distance. Point at someone; they drink 6.

cards.title: The Frost Wedding
cards.rules: A frost-giant wedding wants the view, and you're in every portrait. Smile, then roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! You're in the portrait forever. Drink 8.
You're in the portrait forever. Drink 4.
You show them a better spot. Give 4.
Natural 20! You show them a better spot. Give 8.

cards.title: The Frost Lord
cards.rules: He owns the pass, the peaks and, he thinks, you. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! He has you thrown off the mountain, gently. Drink 12.
He has you thrown off the mountain, gently. Drink 6.
You claim the peak below his. Give 6 to the richest-looking player here.
Natural 20! You claim the peak below his. Give 12 to the richest-looking player here.

spoils.name: Frost Lord's Key
spoils.rules: +1 satchel slot. Comes with a Healing Potion.

cards.title: The Yeti King
cards.rules: The biggest yeti there is. Every other yeti on the mountain just turned to look. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Fur fist. Drink 12.
Fur fist. Drink 6.
You crown yourself. Give 6, split among your subjects.
Natural 20! You crown yourself. Give 12, split among your subjects.

cards.title: The Storm Giant
cards.rules: He throws lightning for fun, and tonight he brought you some. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Struck. Drink 12.
Struck. Drink 6.
You ground him. Touch someone's shoulder, zap; they drink 6.
Natural 20! You ground him. Touch someone's shoulder, zap; they drink 12.

spoils.name: Storm Coat
spoils.rules: Every heal heals 1 more. Traps hurt 1 less.

cards.title: The Griffin Rider
cards.rules: He landed on the pass and won't leave until somebody pays. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! You're paying. Drink 12.
You're paying. Drink 6.
Free ride. Pick a co-pilot; you both give 6.
Natural 20! Free ride. Pick a co-pilot; you both give 12.

cards.title: Emberfang
cards.rules: A red dragon uncoils from a hill of gold, and the air catches fire. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! It sits on you. Drink 6.
Fire, everywhere. Drink 3.
Your blade finds a loose scale. Give 4.
Natural 20! You cut a wing. Everyone else drinks 4.

calm.name: Fire Breath
calm.rules: Everyone drinks 2. Glasses held up as shields drink 1 instead.

calm.name: Tail Swipe
calm.rules: The drawer's two neighbors drink 3.

calm.name: Takes Flight
calm.rules: It circles overhead. Everyone looks up until the roll. This swing is 2 harder.

calm.name: Gold Fever
calm.rules: Everyone points at the greediest player. Most fingers drinks 3.

calm.name: Roar
calm.rules: Last to cover both ears drinks 3.

calm.name: Hoard Slide
calm.rules: A wave of coins. Last to lift both feet drinks 3.

enraged.name: Inferno
enraged.rules: Everyone drinks 3.

enraged.name: Wing Buffet
enraged.rules: Everyone leans back. Last to lean drinks 3.

enraged.name: Molten Gold
enraged.rules: The drawer and whoever they point at drink 3.

enraged.name: Smoke
enraged.rules: Eyes shut until the roll. Peek: drink 2. This swing is 2 harder.

enraged.name: Mocking Laugh
enraged.rules: Everyone laughs like a dragon. Weakest laugh, by vote, drinks 3.

enraged.name: Counts Its Gold
enraged.rules: It turns its back to count its gold. This swing is 2 easier.

enrage.rules: Out-roar it: everyone roars for five seconds. Anyone stops early: Lost, and they drink 4.

lore: It hates the sound of bells.
Its true name is Cinder, and it hates it.

cards.title: Gorgrath the Hungry
cards.rules: It has eaten three knights today, and it's still hungry. It's looking at you. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! It swallows you whole, then spits you out. Drink 6.
A bite. Drink 3.
You jam a spear in its jaw. Give 4.
Natural 20! It chokes on the spear. Everyone else drinks 4.

calm.name: Snatch
calm.rules: It eats the drawer's drink. Pour them a new one; they drink 2 of it.

calm.name: Sniff
calm.rules: It sniffs for dinner. Everyone freezes; first to move drinks 3.

calm.name: Gnaw
calm.rules: Everyone chews loudly until the roll. This swing is 2 harder.

calm.name: Glass Swap
calm.rules: Everyone passes their drink left and sips the new one.

calm.name: Feeding Time
calm.rules: The drawer gives their left neighbor a sip from their glass. Spill any: drink 3.

calm.name: Belly Rumble
calm.rules: The floor shakes. Last to grab the table drinks 3.

enraged.name: Devour
enraged.rules: Everyone drinks 3.

enraged.name: Gulp
enraged.rules: The drawer's two neighbors drink 3.

enraged.name: Crunch
enraged.rules: Last to hide their glass under the table drinks 3.

enraged.name: Full Mouth
enraged.rules: Everyone puffs out their cheeks until the roll. This swing is 2 harder.

enraged.name: Second Helping
enraged.rules: The drawer names a food. Everyone who ate it today drinks 2.

enraged.name: Food Coma
enraged.rules: It yawns, stuffed. This swing is 2 easier.

enrage.rules: Everyone names a food in turn, twice round. A stall or repeat: Lost, and that player drinks 4.

lore: It cannot stand a full plate left alone.

cards.title: Ashmaw the Ancient
cards.rules: The oldest dragon there is, and it has been waiting for you in particular. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! It yawns, and you fall in. Drink 6 and a glass of water.
It remembers you. Drink 3.
You surprise it, and nothing surprises it. Give 4.
Natural 20! It laughs, and you strike its throat. Everyone else drinks 4.

calm.name: Ancient Flame
calm.rules: Slow, old fire. Everyone drinks 2.

calm.name: Old Story
calm.rules: It begins a story. Nobody speaks until the roll. Speak: drink 2.

calm.name: Patience
calm.rules: The drawer counts slowly to ten before rolling. This swing is 2 harder.

calm.name: Long Memory
calm.rules: Everyone who drank on the last card drinks 2 more.

calm.name: Said It Before
calm.rules: The drawer says a sentence. Anyone who repeats a word of it before the roll drinks 3.

calm.name: Dust of Ages
calm.rules: Dust everywhere. Everyone blows on their glass; last to blow drinks 3.

enraged.name: Age of Fire
enraged.rules: Everyone drinks 3.

enraged.name: Forgotten Kings
enraged.rules: Everyone names a king in turn. Stall or repeat: drink 3.

enraged.name: Crushing Years
enraged.rules: The oldest and the youngest players drink 3.

enraged.name: Eclipse
enraged.rules: The sun goes out. Eyes shut until the roll. This swing is 2 harder.

enraged.name: Silence
enraged.rules: Not a word from anyone until the roll. Speak: drink 3.

enraged.name: Dozes Off
enraged.rules: It nods off mid-fight. This swing is 2 easier.

enrage.rules: Everyone tells it something new. The drawer calls any dud: Lost, and that player drinks 4.

lore: Its name is the first word anyone spoke.

cards.title: Rimeclaw
cards.rules: A white dragon in the frozen dark, with eyes like old ice. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Frozen to the floor. Drink 6.
Frostbite. Drink 3.
You chip a claw. Give 4.
Natural 20! Its breath freezes its own jaw shut. Everyone else drinks 4.

calm.name: Frost Breath
calm.rules: Everyone drinks 2. A glass held in both hands drinks 1 instead.

calm.name: Freeze
calm.rules: Everyone freezes. First to move before the roll drinks 3.

calm.name: Ice Wall
calm.rules: The drawer rolls with their other hand. This swing is 2 harder.

calm.name: Cold Stare
calm.rules: The drawer and their left neighbor stare. First to blink drinks 3.

calm.name: Hail
calm.rules: Everyone drums the table like hail. When the drawer stops, last to stop drinks 3.

calm.name: Black Ice
calm.rules: Last to put both feet flat on the floor drinks 3.

enraged.name: Blizzard
enraged.rules: Everyone drinks 3.

enraged.name: Deep Freeze
enraged.rules: Everyone freezes. First to move before the roll drinks 4.

enraged.name: Ice Spikes
enraged.rules: The drawer and both neighbors drink 3.

enraged.name: Snow Blind
enraged.rules: Everyone covers one eye until the roll. This swing is 2 harder.

enraged.name: Shatter
enraged.rules: Everyone clinks glasses, hard. Spill a drop: drink 3.

enraged.name: Thin Ice
enraged.rules: It cracks the ice under itself. This swing is 2 easier.

enrage.rules: Everyone freezes for ten seconds, silent. Anyone moves or laughs: Lost, and they drink 4.

lore: The ice on its throat is thin.
Its name is the sound of a lake cracking.

cards.title: Stormcrown
cards.rules: A blue dragon riding its own storm, crackling with every breath. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! You were holding your sword up. Drink 6.
Struck by lightning. Drink 3.
You ground it with your sword. Give 4.
Natural 20! Its own lightning finds it. Everyone else drinks 4.

calm.name: Lightning
calm.rules: On three, everyone claps. Last clap drinks 2.

calm.name: Thunder
calm.rules: Count to five around the table, fast. A miss drinks 3.

calm.name: Gale
calm.rules: Everyone holds their glass down until the roll. This swing is 2 harder.

calm.name: Showboat
calm.rules: Everyone strikes a pose. The table votes the worst, who drinks 3.

calm.name: Static
calm.rules: Whoever touches a neighbor before the roll drinks 3.

calm.name: Chain Lightning
calm.rules: The drawer drinks 1, the next player clockwise 2, the next 3.

enraged.name: Supercell
enraged.rules: Everyone drinks 3.

enraged.name: Ball Lightning
enraged.rules: Pass a cup clockwise until the drawer says stop. Whoever holds it drinks 3.

enraged.name: Thunderclap
enraged.rules: On three, everyone slaps the table. Last slap drinks 3.

enraged.name: Eye of the Storm
enraged.rules: Everyone spins once in their seat before the roll. This swing is 2 harder.

enraged.name: Rolling Thunder
enraged.rules: Everyone drums the table faster and faster. First to stop drinks 3.

enraged.name: Spent Spark
enraged.rules: Its storm sputters out. This swing is 2 easier.

enrage.rules: Count to ten around the table, clapping on every third number. A miss: Lost; that player drinks 4.

jinx.name: Thunderstruck
jinx.rule: The cursed player shouts 'boom' after every drink. Forgets: drink 1.

cards.title: Glimmerwing
cards.rules: A golden dragon who wants to be admired first and fought second. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! You stop to admire yourself in its scales. Drink 6.
Blinded by the shine. Drink 3.
You call it ugly. It staggers. Give 4.
Natural 20! You show it a mirror. Everyone else drinks 4.

calm.name: Dazzle
calm.rules: Everyone shields their eyes. Last to drinks 2.
