calm.name: Compliment Me
calm.rules: The drawer compliments it. If the table boos, the drawer drinks 3.

calm.name: Pose
calm.rules: It strikes a pose. Everyone copies it until the roll. This swing is 2 harder.

calm.name: Mirror Mirror
calm.rules: The drawer copies their left neighbor's moves until the roll. Slip: drink 3.

calm.name: Preening
calm.rules: Everyone fixes their hair. Last to drinks 3.

calm.name: Golden Glare
calm.rules: Whoever wears the most gold or yellow drinks 3.

enraged.name: Blinding Flash
enraged.rules: Everyone drinks 3.

enraged.name: Jealous Wing
enraged.rules: The best-dressed player, by vote, drinks 3.

enraged.name: Gilded Claw
enraged.rules: Everyone wearing jewelry drinks 3. Nobody? The drawer drinks 3.

enraged.name: Prism
enraged.rules: Light everywhere. Everyone squints until the roll. This swing is 2 harder.

enraged.name: Vanity
enraged.rules: Everyone says one nice thing about it. A dud drinks 3.

enraged.name: Distracted
enraged.rules: It stops to admire itself in a puddle. This swing is 2 easier.

enrage.rules: Everyone compliments it, in turn. A stall or a repeat: Lost, and that player drinks 4.

lore: The gold is paint on its belly.
It fears a mirror at dawn.

jinx.name: Dazzled
jinx.rule: The cursed player compliments the dragon before every sip. Forgets: drink 1.

cards.title: Old Mother Brine
cards.rules: Older than the sea and twice as wet. She has eaten heroes for lunch. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! She tucks you in, under the sea. Drink 6.
Swallowed, then spat out. Drink 3.
You tangle her in the kelp. Give 4.
Natural 20! She chokes on your boot. Everyone else drinks 4.

calm.name: Undertow
calm.rules: Everyone sways left, then right. Last to sway drinks 2.

calm.name: Riddle
calm.rules: The left neighbor asks a riddle; the drawer has ten seconds. Wrong: drink 3.

calm.name: Seaweed Wrap
calm.rules: Everyone holds hands with their neighbors until the roll. This swing is 2 harder.

calm.name: Say Please
calm.rules: Everyone says please before speaking, until the roll. Forget: drink 3.

calm.name: Mother Knows
calm.rules: Everyone points at who needs a nap. Most fingers drinks 3.

calm.name: Tidal Slap
calm.rules: The drawer's two neighbors drink 2.

enraged.name: Tidal Wave
enraged.rules: Everyone drinks 3.

enraged.name: Hungry Again
enraged.rules: She eats the drawer's supper. The drawer drinks 3.

enraged.name: Drag Under
enraged.rules: Last to set their glass on the floor drinks 3.

enraged.name: Ink Cloud
enraged.rules: Everyone hides their face in their hands until the roll. This swing is 2 harder.

enraged.name: Lullaby
enraged.rules: Everyone hums a lullaby. First to laugh drinks 3.

enraged.name: Too Full
enraged.rules: She burps up a sailor and loses her place. This swing is 2 easier.

enrage.rules: The left neighbor asks a riddle. Ten seconds: wrong or silent is Lost, and the drawer drinks 4.

lore: Her name is the tide table.

cards.title: The Whispering Wyrm
cards.rules: A dragon that speaks in your own voice and tells your secrets. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! It tells all of yours. Drink 6.
It tells one. Drink 3.
You talk louder. Give 4.
Natural 20! You tell its secrets. Everyone else drinks 4.

calm.name: Whisper
calm.rules: Everyone whispers until the roll. Speak up: drink 2.

calm.name: A Secret
calm.rules: The drawer whispers a secret to their left neighbor, who rates it. Dull: drink 3.

calm.name: Coil
calm.rules: Everyone hugs themselves until the roll. This swing is 2 harder.

calm.name: Hiss
calm.rules: Everyone hisses. When the drawer stops, last to stop drinks 3.

calm.name: Rumor
calm.rules: Everyone points at who keeps the most secrets. Most fingers drinks 3.

calm.name: Tell-Tale
calm.rules: Whoever spoke last before this card drinks 3.

enraged.name: Scream
enraged.rules: Everyone drinks 3.

enraged.name: Confession
enraged.rules: Everyone confesses one small thing. Refuse: drink 3.

enraged.name: Every Name
enraged.rules: The drawer names everyone at the table in five seconds. Miss one: drink 3.

enraged.name: Stolen Voice
enraged.rules: It speaks as the drawer, who may not talk until the roll. This swing is 2 harder.

enraged.name: Overheard
enraged.rules: Everyone repeats the last thing someone said. Wrong: drink 3.

enraged.name: Gossip
enraged.rules: It stops to gossip with itself. This swing is 2 easier.

enrage.rules: Everyone confesses one small thing, in turn. Anyone refuses: Lost, and they drink 4.

lore: It has no scales under the jaw.
Its name is the thing you never said.

jinx.name: Tongue-Tied
jinx.rule: The cursed player can only mime. Say a word: drink 1.

cards.title: Tidewrack
cards.rules: A sea dragon hung with the bells of every ship it sank. They all ring. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! You're hung on the reef like a bell. Drink 6.
A wave of bells breaks over you. Drink 3.
You cut a bell loose. It sinks. Give 4.
Natural 20! It rings its own bell and goes deaf. Everyone else drinks 4.

calm.name: Rocking Deck
calm.rules: Everyone sways with the waves until the roll. Stop: drink 2.

calm.name: Bail!
calm.rules: Everyone mimes bailing water. Last to start drinks 3.

calm.name: Heavy Swell
calm.rules: Everyone holds their glass with one finger until the roll. This swing is 2 harder.

calm.name: Fog Bell
calm.rules: Everyone rings a pretend bell. Last ding drinks 3.

calm.name: Shanty
calm.rules: The drawer starts a shanty; everyone joins. First to stop drinks 3.

calm.name: Man Overboard
calm.rules: The drawer's left neighbor is overboard. They drink 3 to climb back.

enraged.name: Shipwreck
enraged.rules: Everyone drinks 3.

enraged.name: Breaker
enraged.rules: Last to grab the edge of the table drinks 3.

enraged.name: Bell Storm
enraged.rules: Every bell rings. Last to cover their ears drinks 3.

enraged.name: Capsize
enraged.rules: Everyone tilts their head sideways until the roll. This swing is 2 harder.

enraged.name: Abandon Ship
enraged.rules: Everyone stands; last to sit back down drinks 3.

enraged.name: Lost Bell
enraged.rules: It dives after a bell it dropped. This swing is 2 easier.

enrage.rules: Everyone sings one line of a shanty, in turn. Whoever breaks the rhythm: Lost, and they drink 4.

lore: A harpoon is still in its side.
Its name is rung, not said.

previousRoll.instruction: You have a cape. It's a blanket, but still. Give 3.

cards.title: Barbarian
cards.rules: Rage first. Questions never. +1 to monster d20s. +2 to boss d20s. Traps hurt 1 more.

evolves.title: Berserker
evolves.rules: +2 max hearts. +1 to monster d20s. +2 to elite and boss d20s. Traps hurt 1 more.

evolves.title: Warlord
evolves.rules: +3 max hearts. +1 to monster d20s. +2 to elite d20s. +3 to boss d20s.

evolves.title: Destroyer
evolves.rules: +3 max hearts. +2 to monster d20s. +3 to elite and boss d20s.

cards.title: Rogue
cards.rules: Took that. +2 to trap and relic d20s. +1 to ambush d20s. +1 satchel slot. Starts with a Smoke Bomb.

evolves.title: Cutpurse
evolves.rules: +1 to monster and ambush d20s. +3 to trap d20s. +2 to relic d20s. +1 satchel slot.

evolves.title: Shadow
evolves.rules: +2 to monster d20s. +3 to trap and relic d20s. +1 to ambush d20s. +2 satchel slots.

evolves.title: Guildmaster
evolves.rules: +2 to monster and ambush d20s. +3 to trap and relic d20s. +2 satchel slots.

cards.title: Cleric
cards.rules: Blesses every drink, loudly. +1 max heart. Every heal heals 1 more.

evolves.title: Priest
evolves.rules: +2 max hearts. Every heal heals 1 more.

evolves.title: High Priest
evolves.rules: +2 max hearts. Every heal heals 2 more.

evolves.title: Saint
evolves.rules: +3 max hearts. Every heal heals 2 more.

cards.title: Wizard
cards.rules: Smells of burnt eyebrows. −1 max heart. Starts with a Lucky Coin.

evolves.title: Sorcerer
evolves.rules: A fresh Lucky Coin whenever a boss falls.

evolves.title: Archmage
evolves.rules: +1 max heart. +1 to every battle d20. A fresh Lucky Coin whenever a boss falls.

evolves.title: Grand Magus
evolves.rules: +1 max heart. +1 to every battle d20. Natural 20 on a 19 or 20. A fresh Lucky Coin whenever a boss falls.

cards.title: Bard
cards.rules: Brought a lute. Nobody asked. +1 max heart. Natural 20 on a 19 or 20. Every heal heals 1 more.

evolves.title: Minstrel
evolves.rules: +1 max heart. Natural 20 on 18 to 20. Every heal heals 1 more.

evolves.title: Troubadour
evolves.rules: +2 max hearts. +1 to every battle d20. Natural 20 on 18 to 20. Every heal heals 1 more.

evolves.title: Living Legend
evolves.rules: +2 max hearts. +1 to every battle d20. Natural 20 on 17 to 20. Every heal heals 1 more.

cards.title: Paladin
cards.rules: Sworn to protect, loudly. +1 max heart. +1 to boss d20s. Starts with a Tower Shield.

evolves.title: Crusader
evolves.rules: +2 max hearts. +1 to boss d20s.

evolves.title: Templar
evolves.rules: +2 max hearts. +2 to boss d20s.

evolves.title: Lightbringer
evolves.rules: +2 max hearts. +1 to boss d20s. Bosses hurt 1 less.

cards.title: Ranger
cards.rules: Hasn't slept indoors in years. +2 to monster d20s. +1 to ambush d20s. Bosses hurt 1 more.

evolves.title: Tracker
evolves.rules: +2 to monster d20s. +3 to ambush d20s.

evolves.title: Beastmaster
evolves.rules: +2 max hearts. +3 to monster and ambush d20s.

evolves.title: Warden of the Wild
evolves.rules: +2 max hearts. +3 to monster and ambush d20s. +1 to boss d20s.

cards.title: Drunken Monk
cards.rules: Starts drunk. Gets better. −1 max heart. Natural 1 on a 1 or 2.

evolves.title: Brawler
evolves.rules: +1 to every battle d20.

evolves.title: Drunken Master
evolves.rules: +1 max heart. +2 to every battle d20. Natural 20 on a 19 or 20.

evolves.title: Grandmaster
evolves.rules: +2 max hearts. +2 to every battle d20. Natural 20 on 18 to 20.

cards.title: Necromancer
cards.rules: Has died twice this week already. −3 max hearts. +1 to boss d20s. Starts with a Phoenix Feather.

evolves.title: Bone Caller
evolves.rules: −3 max hearts. +2 to boss d20s.

evolves.title: Lich
evolves.rules: −3 max hearts. +3 to boss d20s.

evolves.title: Lord of Bones
evolves.rules: −2 max hearts. +1 to elite d20s. +3 to boss d20s.

cards.title: Alchemist
cards.rules: Has a flask for every flask. +1 max heart. +1 satchel slot. Starts with 2 Healing Potions.

evolves.title: Apothecary
evolves.rules: +1 max heart. Every heal heals 1 more. +1 satchel slot.

evolves.title: Master Alchemist
evolves.rules: +1 max heart. Every heal heals 1 more. A fresh Healing Potion whenever a boss falls. +2 satchel slots.

evolves.title: Philosopher
evolves.rules: +2 max hearts. Every heal heals 1 more. A fresh Healing Potion whenever a boss falls. +2 satchel slots.

cards.title: Warlock
cards.rules: Read none of the pact. −2 max hearts. +2 to every battle d20.

evolves.title: Hexblade
evolves.rules: −2 max hearts. +2 to every battle d20. Natural 20 on a 19 or 20.

evolves.title: Archfiend
evolves.rules: −1 max heart. +2 to every battle d20. Natural 20 on a 19 or 20.

evolves.title: Soul Broker
evolves.rules: −2 max hearts. +3 to every battle d20. Natural 20 on a 19 or 20.

cards.title: Knight
cards.rules: Mentions the armor daily. +2 max hearts. +1 to monster d20s. Ambushes hurt 1 less.

evolves.title: Knight Errant
evolves.rules: +2 max hearts. +1 to monster and ambush d20s. Ambushes hurt 1 less.

evolves.title: Knight Commander
evolves.rules: +2 max hearts. +1 to monster d20s. +2 to ambush d20s. Ambushes hurt 1 less.

evolves.title: Lord Protector
evolves.rules: +2 max hearts. +1 to monster and boss d20s. +2 to ambush d20s. Ambushes hurt 1 less.

cards.title: Innkeeper
cards.rules: Knows every rumor. +1 max heart. +1 satchel slot. Starts with a Hired Sword and a Healing Potion.

evolves.title: Tavern Master
evolves.rules: +1 max heart. Every heal heals 1 more. +1 satchel slot.

evolves.title: Master Brewer
evolves.rules: +1 max heart. Every heal heals 1 more. A fresh Healing Potion whenever a boss falls. +1 satchel slot.

evolves.title: Lord of Feasts
evolves.rules: +2 max hearts. Every heal heals 1 more. A fresh Healing Potion whenever a boss falls. +2 satchel slots.

cards.title: Sellsword
cards.rules: Will fight anything for coin. +1 max heart. +1 to monster d20s. +3 to elite d20s.

evolves.title: Bounty Hunter
evolves.rules: +1 max heart. +1 to monster and boss d20s. +3 to elite d20s.

evolves.title: Legend for Hire
evolves.rules: +3 max hearts. +2 to monster d20s. +3 to elite d20s. +1 to boss d20s.

evolves.title: Captain of Blades
evolves.rules: +4 max hearts. +2 to monster and boss d20s. +3 to elite d20s.

cards.title: Druid
cards.rules: Talks to the trees. The trees talk back. +1 max heart. +2 to trap d20s. Every heal heals 1 more.

evolves.title: Shapeshifter
evolves.rules: +1 max heart. +1 to monster and ambush d20s. +2 to trap d20s. Every heal heals 1 more.

evolves.title: Archdruid
evolves.rules: +2 max hearts. +2 to monster, trap and ambush d20s. Every heal heals 1 more.

evolves.title: Voice of the Wild
evolves.rules: +3 max hearts. +2 to monster and ambush d20s. +3 to trap d20s. Every heal heals 1 more.

cards.title: The Peasant
cards.rules: Brought dad's pitchfork. −3 max hearts. −1 to boss d20s. Every 20 is rerolled. Traps hurt 1 more.

evolves.title: The Angry Peasant
evolves.rules: −3 max hearts. −1 to boss d20s. Every 20 is rerolled. Traps hurt 1 more. −1 satchel slot.

evolves.title: The Angry Mob
evolves.rules: −3 max hearts. −1 to boss d20s. Every 20 is rerolled. Traps hurt 1 more. −1 satchel slot.

evolves.title: The Peasant Revolt
evolves.rules: −3 max hearts. −1 to boss d20s. Every 20 is rerolled. Traps hurt 1 more. −1 satchel slot.

cards.title: The Squire
cards.rules: Drops things. −2 max hearts. Natural 1 on a 1 or 2. Every heal heals 1 less. −2 satchel slots.

evolves.title: Senior Squire
evolves.rules: −2 max hearts. Natural 1 on 1 to 3. Every heal heals 1 less. −2 satchel slots.

evolves.title: Squire of the Year
evolves.rules: −2 max hearts. Natural 1 on 1 to 3. Every heal heals 1 less. −2 satchel slots.

evolves.title: The Eternal Squire
evolves.rules: −2 max hearts. Natural 1 on 1 to 3. Every heal heals 1 less. −2 satchel slots.

cards.title: The Mimic
cards.rules: A very confused chest. −5 max hearts. −1 to every battle d20. −1 to monster d20s. +2 satchel slots.

evolves.title: Bigger Chest
evolves.rules: −5 max hearts. −1 to every battle d20. −1 to monster d20s. +2 satchel slots.

evolves.title: Storage Unit
evolves.rules: −5 max hearts. −2 to every battle d20. −1 to monster d20s. +2 satchel slots.

evolves.title: Treasure Vault
evolves.rules: −5 max hearts. −2 to every battle d20. −1 to monster d20s. +2 satchel slots.

cards.title: A Week of Rain
cards.rules: Last to say 'squelch' as a region opens drinks 1. Traps hurt 1 more. Take a Smoke Bomb.

boon.name: A Week of Rain
boon.rules: Last to say 'squelch' as a region opens drinks 1. Traps hurt 1 more. Starts with a Smoke Bomb.

cards.title: Harvest Festival
cards.rules: Feasts in every village: whoever drinks picks someone to drink with them. Heals heal 1 more.

boon.name: Harvest Festival
boon.rules: Whoever drinks picks someone to drink with them. Every heal heals 1 more.

cards.title: The King's Advance
cards.rules: The king pays up front: drink 1. Start two hearts short, with a Tower Shield and a Healing Potion.

boon.name: The King's Advance
boon.rules: −2 max hearts. Starts with a Tower Shield and a Healing Potion.

cards.title: Curfew
cards.rules: Ask to leave your seat, or drink 2. Bosses take an extra hit. Take a Lucky Coin and a shield.

boon.name: Curfew
boon.rules: Ask to leave your seat, or drink 2. Bosses take 1 more hit. Starts with a Lucky Coin and a Tower Shield.

cards.title: A Bottomless Bag
cards.rules: A bag bigger on the inside: drink 3. One more satchel slot.

boon.name: A Bottomless Bag
boon.rules: +1 satchel slot.

cards.title: Butterfingers
cards.rules: Anyone who drops anything drinks 2. One satchel slot fewer, but two more hearts.

boon.name: Butterfingers
boon.rules: Anyone who drops anything drinks 2. +2 max hearts. −1 satchel slot.

cards.title: Blood Moon
cards.rules: Everyone howls at the red moon; last to howl drinks 2. Fights cost a heart more; two more hearts.

boon.name: Blood Moon
boon.rules: +2 max hearts. Monsters, elites and ambushes hurt 1 more.

cards.title: The Oath
cards.rules: Everyone swears to drink only with their off hand all quest. Caught using the other: drink 1.

boon.name: The Oath
boon.rules: Everyone swears to drink only with their off hand all quest. Caught using the other: drink 1.

cards.title: Battle Hymns
cards.rules: Before every boss swing, the drawer sings one line of a battle hymn. Refuse: drink 2.

boon.name: Battle Hymns
boon.rules: Before every boss swing, the drawer sings one line of a battle hymn. Refuse: drink 2.

cards.title: The Town Cheers
cards.rules: The whole town sees you off. Everyone toasts the person on their left. Two more hearts.

boon.name: The Town Cheers
boon.rules: +2 max hearts.

cards.title: A Sleeping Giant
cards.rules: A giant sleeps nearby: everyone whispers. Trials cost a heart more; heals heal one more.

boon.name: A Sleeping Giant
boon.rules: Everyone whispers. Anyone who shouts drinks 1. Every heal heals 1 more. Trials hurt 1 more.

cards.title: The Farewell Toast
cards.rules: Everyone drinks 1 at the city gate. Start a heart short, with a Lucky Coin and a Tower Shield.

boon.name: The Farewell Toast
boon.rules: −1 max heart. Starts with a Lucky Coin and a Tower Shield.

cards.title: A Treasure Map
cards.rules: A treasure map, maybe a fake. Gambles and relics roll 2 higher. Start a heart short.

boon.name: A Treasure Map
boon.rules: −1 max heart. +2 to relic d20s.

cards.title: The Village Healer
cards.rules: The village healer packs you a potion. One more satchel slot, but bosses cost a heart more.

boon.name: The Village Healer
boon.rules: Bosses hurt 1 more. +1 satchel slot. Starts with a Healing Potion.

cards.title: A Black Cat
cards.rules: A black cat crossed your path, twice. Natural 1s land on a 2 too, natural 20s on a 19.

boon.name: A Black Cat
boon.rules: Natural 20 on a 19 or 20. Natural 1 on a 1 or 2.

cards.title: The Riddling Moon
cards.rules: Before each boss, the drawer answers the table's riddle, or drinks 2. Trials cost less, traps more.

boon.name: The Riddling Moon
boon.rules: Before each boss, the drawer answers a riddle from the table, or drinks 2. Trials hurt 1 less. Traps hurt 1 more.

cards.title: Bandit Season
cards.rules: It's bandit season, and they've been practicing. Ambushes cost a heart more. Take a Tower Shield.

boon.name: Bandit Season
boon.rules: Ambushes hurt 1 more. Starts with a Tower Shield.

cards.title: The Royal Wedding
cards.rules: A royal wedding, and the wine is free. Take two Healing Potions, but one satchel slot fewer.

boon.name: The Royal Wedding
boon.rules: −1 satchel slot. Starts with 2 Healing Potions.

cards.title: Heroic Names
cards.rules: Everyone picks a heroic name at the gate and answers only to it. Wrong name: drink 1.

boon.name: Heroic Names
boon.rules: Everyone picks a heroic name at the gate and answers only to it. Wrong name: drink 1.

cards.title: A Falling Star
cards.rules: Everyone wished on a falling star. Every d20 fight rolls 1 higher, but start two hearts short.

boon.name: A Falling Star
boon.rules: −2 max hearts. +1 to every battle d20.

cards.title: The King's Decree
cards.rules: {dragon} has woken under {lair}. Everyone raises a glass to the king.

cards.title: A Burned Village
cards.rules: A village in ashes; {dragon} flew home to {lair}. Everyone drinks 1 for it.

cards.title: The Bounty
cards.rules: WANTED: {dragon}. LAST SEEN: {lair}. Everyone toasts the reward.

cards.title: The Prophecy
cards.rules: A fool will slay {dragon}. Everyone points at the fool; most fingers drinks 2.

cards.title: A Princess Writes
cards.rules: '{dragon} took me to {lair}. Bring cake.' The drawer reads it aloud, sobbing.

cards.title: The Last Survivor
cards.rules: A singed knight gasps '{dragon}... {lair}...' and faints. Everyone toasts him.

cards.title: Sir Bradley's Charter
cards.rules: Sir Bradley has a charter from the king's cousin. Name a bigger patron, then roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! The cousin really is important. Drink 6.
The cousin really is important. Drink 3.
Nobody has heard of the cousin. Give 3 to whoever has the fanciest cousin.
Natural 20! Nobody has heard of the cousin. Give 6 to whoever has the fanciest cousin.

cards.title: Chadwick's Accent
cards.rules: Chadwick says he's a foreign prince. You and he (left neighbor) do the accent. His wins: drink 3.

cards.title: We're Together
cards.rules: Thaddeus tells the gate guard you're his squires. You're not. Roll 2d6 to argue.

outcomes.instruction: The guard believes him. Carry his bags and drink 3.
The guard believes you. Pick someone to be your squire; they drink 3.

dice.doubles: A pair! The guard sends them to the back. Everyone else drinks 2.

cards.title: The Company Banner
cards.rules: The Gilded Company has a banner, a motto and matching capes. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Their capes are better. Drink 6.
Their capes are better. Drink 3.
You have a cape. It's a blanket, but still. Give 3.
Natural 20! You have a cape. It's a blanket, but still. Give 6.

jinx.name: Champion
jinx.rule: Everyone calls the cursed player 'Champion', like Sir Bradley does. Slip: drink 1.

cards.title: The Roll of Heroes
cards.rules: Sir Bradley is on the roll of heroes. You're on a napkin the clerk is holding. Roll d6.

outcomes.instruction: The napkin blows away. Drink 3.
The clerk sneezes on it. Drink 3.
The napkin holds up. Give 2.
You're on the roll, and Bradley's spelled wrong. Give 3.
You're on it twice. Give 3.
Bradley's off the roll. Everyone else drinks 1.

cards.title: The Gate Toll
cards.rules: Chadwick tells the guard you're paying the toll for the whole Company. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! The guard believes him. Drink 6.
The guard believes him. Drink 3.
The guard charges Chadwick double. Give 3, twice, to the same person.
Natural 20! The guard charges Chadwick double. Give 6, twice, to the same person.

cards.title: The Royal Seal
cards.rules: Thaddeus forged a royal seal out of a potato, and he's pressing it on you. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! It works on you. Drink 6.
It works on you. Drink 3.
You wash it off in a horse trough. Seal someone's hand; they drink 3.
Natural 20! You wash it off in a horse trough. Seal someone's hand; they drink 6.

cards.title: Rock, Paper, Bradley
cards.rules: Rock, paper, scissors with your left neighbor (Sir Bradley), best of three. Lose: drink 3.

cards.title: The Road Out
cards.rules: The King's Road is closed for a parade. Forest or marsh? Everyone votes; the drawer decides.

cards.title: The Talking Oak
cards.rules: An old oak asks why you're in its forest. Give it a reason, then roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! It isn't convinced, and drops a branch on you. Drink 6.
It isn't convinced, and drops a branch on you. Drink 3.
It laughs, and the branches part. Give 3.
Natural 20! It laughs so hard it drops every acorn it has. Give 6.

cards.title: Pixie Swarm
cards.rules: A swarm of pixies, giggling and pulling your hair. Roll d6.

outcomes.instruction: One gets in your ear. Drink 3, head tilted.
They tie your laces together. Drink 3.
You swat one. Give 2.
You trap them under a hat. Give 3.
You out-giggle them. Give 3.
They adopt you. Everyone else drinks 1.

cards.title: The Silent Druid
cards.rules: Read alone what the druid is thinking, start the clock, then act it out. The table guesses.

timer.end: Time. Someone guessed it? Give 3. Nobody did? Drink 3.

cards.title: The Howling Hag
cards.rules: Howl at the moon against your left neighbor. The table calls the quieter: drink 3.

cards.title: The Fairy Ring
cards.rules: A ring of red mushrooms, and you're standing in it. Dance a little, then roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! You dance until dawn. Drink 6.
The fairies make you keep dancing. Drink 3.
You dance out of the ring. A puff of spores follows you. Give 2.
Natural 20! You dance out of the ring. A puff of spores follows you. Give 4.

cards.title: The Wisp
cards.rules: A little light in the trees, bobbing, leading you off the path. Roll 2d6.

outcomes.instruction: You follow it into a bog. Drink 3, and say 'which way?'
You blow it out like a candle. Give 3 to whoever looks most lost.

dice.doubles: It leads someone else astray. Everyone else drinks 3.

jinx.name: Wisp-Struck
jinx.rule: Nobody may look the cursed player in the eye. Caught: drink 1.

cards.title: The Hollow Log
cards.rules: On three, everyone points at who'd hide in a hollow log first. Most fingers: drink 2.

cards.title: Pinecones!
cards.rules: A pinecone storm in the canopy. Everyone ducks on three; the last to duck drinks 2.

cards.title: The Acorn Sprite
cards.rules: Your right neighbor throws a mimed acorn. Catch it in your mouth. Booed: drink 3.

cards.title: The Bramble Witch
cards.rules: A witch made of thorns, sure you trampled her garden. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! You did trample it. Drink 6, and say sorry to a plant.
You did trample it. Drink 3, and say sorry to a plant.
You compliment her roses. She blushes thorns. Give 3.
Natural 20! You compliment her roses. She blushes thorns. Give 6.

jinx.name: Thorny
jinx.rule: The cursed player says 'ouch' before every sip. Forgets: drink 1.

cards.title: The Elves' Test
cards.rules: Eyes shut; the elves hand you someone's drink. Name whose it is. Wrong: drink 3.

cards.title: The Heron
cards.rules: Stand on one leg like a heron, eyes shut, for 10 seconds. Wobble or peek: drink 3.

cards.title: The Elf Lord's Wine
cards.rules: Review your drink like a very old elf lord for 15 seconds. Crack a smile: drink 3.

cards.title: Ode to an Oak
cards.rules: Praise your right neighbor like an ancient tree for 20 seconds. Anyone laughs: you drink 3.

cards.title: Falling Branches
cards.rules: A storm in the canopy, and the branches start coming down. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Bonked. Drink 6.
Bonked. Drink 3.
You catch the last one. Give 2, and hand someone your 'branch'.
Natural 20! You catch the last one. Give 4, and hand someone your 'branch'.

cards.title: The Mossy Slope
cards.rules: A slope of wet moss, and the path is at the bottom. Stand up, then roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Down on your backside, in green. Drink 4 standing up.
Down on your backside, in green. Drink 2 standing up.
Not a smudge on you. Give 2.
Natural 20! You slide down it like a sled. Give 4.

cards.title: Snares
cards.rules: Hunters' snares all over the path. Some of them twitch. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Snap. Hung up by one ankle. Drink 4.
Snap. Hung up by one ankle. Drink 2.
You tiptoe through. Give 2 to whoever walks loudest.
Natural 20! You tiptoe through. Give 4 to whoever walks loudest.

cards.title: Midge Cloud
cards.rules: A cloud of midges off the pond, and they brought friends. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! In your mouth. Drink 4 with a hand over your glass.
In your mouth. Drink 2 with a hand over your glass.
Swatted. Give 2.
Natural 20! Swatted. Give 4.

cards.title: The Elf Patrol
cards.rules: Four elves who find humans adorable. Name a song you'd sing them, then roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! They pat you on the head. Drink 4.
They pat you on the head. Drink 2.
They're charmed and wave you on. Give 2.
Natural 20! They're charmed and wave you on. Give 4.

cards.title: The Woodpecker
cards.rules: A woodpecker goes to work on the tree beside you. Everyone does a woodpecker; the worst drinks 2.

cards.title: The Green Man
cards.rules: Everyone says 'the forest remembers' as a threat. The table picks the scariest; they give 3.

cards.title: The Moss Troll
cards.rules: A troll covered in moss, and very itchy about it. Roll 2d6.

outcomes.instruction: It scratches on you. Drink 3, then say 'moss troll' five times fast.
You scratch its back for it. Give 3.

dice.doubles: A pair! It scratches itself to sleep. Everyone else drinks 2.

cards.title: Name That Tree
cards.rules: Your left neighbor names three trees, one made up. Spot the fake. Wrong: drink 3.

cards.title: The Sinkhole
cards.rules: Leaves over a hole, and the hole is full of mud. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! You wade through. Drink 4, and squelch.
You wade through. Drink 2, and squelch.
You vault it. Give 2.
Natural 20! You vault it. Give 4.

cards.title: The Hunting Party
cards.rules: A lord's hunting party, and you look a lot like a deer. Shout 'not a deer!', then roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! They're not convinced. Drink 4.
They're not convinced. Drink 2.
They apologize and ride off. Give 2.
Natural 20! They apologize and ride off. Give 4.

cards.title: Mushroom Roulette
cards.rules: Six mushrooms, one of them poison. Win, then cash out or eat again, harder. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Poison. Drink 6.
Poison. Drink 3.
Delicious. Give 2.
Natural 20! Delicious. Give 4.

cards.title: The Hollow Oak
cards.rules: A hollow oak with something glinting inside. Reach in, or leave it.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Something in there bites. Drink 8.
Something in there bites. Drink 4.
A shield, wedged in the wood. Give 3.
Natural 20! A shield, wedged in the wood. Give 6.

cards.title: The Fairy Mound
cards.rules: A grassy mound with a door the size of a hand. Knock, or leave it.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! The fairies are furious. Drink 8.
The fairies are furious. Drink 4.
They trade you a potion. Bow to someone; they drink 3.
Natural 20! They trade you a potion. Bow to someone; they drink 6.

jinx.name: Fairy Manners
jinx.rule: The cursed player drinks with their pinky out. Caught without it: drink 1.

cards.title: A Hunter's Pack
cards.rules: A pack hung on a branch: rope, jerky and a smoke bomb. Chew some pretend jerky, loudly.

cards.title: Healing Herbs
cards.rules: A patch of healing herbs in a sunbeam. Sniff your drink like a healer, and brew a potion.

cards.title: The Elf Feast
cards.rules: An elf feast, left out for travelers. Everyone toasts the cook.

cards.title: The Fairy Lights
cards.rules: A clearing full of floating lights. Everyone makes a wish and blows on one.

cards.title: The White Stag
cards.rules: A white stag watches from the trees, and the forest goes still. Everyone raises a glass, silently.

cards.title: The Mushroom Man
cards.rules: An old man with a basket swears every mushroom is safe. He insists you taste one.

cards.title: The Shortcut
cards.rules: A woodcutter swears the shortcut through the thorns saves a day. He has never taken it.

cards.title: The Hollow Tree
cards.rules: A hollow tree to crawl through, or the long way round. Something inside giggles.

cards.title: The Wishing Tree
cards.rules: Shake the tree for a gift, until it drops a beehive. Cash out or shake again. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Beehive. Drink 6.
Beehive. Drink 3.
A gift falls. Give 2.
Natural 20! A gift falls. Give 4.

cards.title: Campfire Cooking
cards.rules: Everyone names what they'd cook over a campfire. The table boos the worst; they drink 2.

cards.title: The Elf Stare
cards.rules: Everyone stares like a wise old elf and holds eye contact. First to laugh drinks 2.

cards.title: Your Tree
cards.rules: Everyone says what tree they'd be. The table picks the strangest; they drink 2.

cards.title: The Forest Toast
cards.rules: Everyone clinks with everyone, eyes locked, or the forest takes offense. Skip someone: drink 1.

cards.title: Animal Calls
cards.rules: Everyone does an animal call, fast, around the table. Repeat an animal or stall: drink 2.

elite.title: The Elf Archer
elite.rules: She has never missed, and she's very polite about it. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! An arrow through your hat. Drink 8, and tip it.
An arrow through your hat. Drink 4, and tip it.
You hide behind a tree she can't see around. Give 4.
Natural 20! You hide behind a tree she can't see around. Give 8.

elite.title: The Treant
elite.rules: Two tons of walking oak, and you stepped on its roots. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Stomped. Drink 8, then stomp your feet for 5 seconds.
Stomped. Drink 4, then stomp your feet for 5 seconds.
Firewood. Give 4.
Natural 20! Firewood. Give 8.

elite.title: The Woodcutter
elite.rules: He knows every tree in this forest, and you broke one. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! He makes you stack wood. Drink 8.
He makes you stack wood. Drink 4.
You blame a beaver. He believes you. Give 4.
Natural 20! You blame a beaver. He believes you. Give 8.

spoils.name: Woodcutter's Pack
spoils.rules: +1 satchel slot. Comes with a Tower Shield.

elite.title: The Faerie Bard
elite.rules: A faerie bard who needs a villain for her new song, and has picked you. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! You're the villain of the song. Drink 8, and bow.
You're the villain of the song. Drink 4, and bow.
You hum over her until she gives up. Give 4.
Natural 20! You hum over her until she gives up. Give 8.

cards.title: The Fairy Court
cards.rules: The fair folk offer a gift and never say the price. Everyone bows to the queen.

cards.title: The Oldest Tree
cards.rules: It has watched every hero pass, and it has notes. The drawer reads them aloud.

cards.title: The Hunter's Feast
cards.rules: A lord's feast in a clearing, and you were not invited. Everyone grabs a bite.

cards.title: The Wolf King
cards.rules: He means to eat you first. Side bets: thumbs up or down; wrong bets drink 1. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! He takes a bite. Drink 8.
He takes a bite. Drink 4.
You knock out a fang. Give 5.
Natural 20! He runs off yelping. Everyone else drinks 3.

phases.rules: He circles you. Staring contest with your left neighbor, playing the wolf. Blink first: drink 3.

jinx.name: Howler
jinx.rule: The cursed player howls after every sip. Forgets: drink 1.

cards.title: The Faerie Queen
cards.rules: She sits on a throne of thorns and judges your manners. Curtsy, then roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Off with your head, briefly. Finish your drink.
Your manners are basic. Drink 4.
You cut down her throne, and she tumbles. Give 5.
Natural 20! You cut down her throne, and she tumbles. Give 10.

jinx.name: Curtsy Court
jinx.rule: The cursed player curtsies before every drink. Forgets: drink 1.

spoils.name: Faerie Scepter
spoils.rules: +2 to elite d20s. +1 to boss d20s.

phases.rules: She demands a toast. Give her one, ten seconds, no ums; the table judges. Fail: drink 3.

cards.title: The Old Bear
cards.rules: A bear older than the forest, woken from a very long nap. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! He sits on you. Drink 8.
He sits on you. Drink 4.
You hand him honey, and he wanders off. Give 5.
Natural 20! He falls back asleep on the spot. Everyone else drinks 3.

phases.rules: He sniffs you for honey. Roll 2d6 to prove you have none.

outcomes.instruction: You have honey on you. Drink 4.
Empty-handed. Give 4.

cards.title: The Green Knight
cards.rules: Twelve feet tall and green as moss. Side bets: thumbs up or down; wrong bets drink 1. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! He takes your head and keeps it a while. Drink 8.
He takes your head, then gives it back. Drink 4.
You land a blow he'll remember. Give 5.
Natural 20! You land a blow he'll remember. Give 10.

phases.rules: His game: you strike, then he does. Arm-wrestle your left neighbor, playing him. Lose: drink 3.

cards.title: The Hungry Wood
cards.rules: The trees close in, and one of them has a mouth. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Swallowed by roots. Drink 8.
Swallowed by roots. Drink 4.
You find the tree with the mouth and kick it. Give 5.
Natural 20! You turn the other trees against it. Everyone else drinks 3.

spoils.name: Wishing Acorns
spoils.rules: Comes with a Lucky Coin and a Healing Potion.

phases.rules: The roots grab for you. Roll d6.

outcomes.instruction: They drag you under. Drink 4.
They grab your foot. Drink 3.
You jump them. Give 3.
You stamp on one. Give 3.
They tangle each other up. Give 4.
You ride a root out. Everyone else drinks 2.

jinx.name: Root-Bound
jinx.rule: The cursed player keeps both feet flat on the floor. Lifts one: drink 1.

cards.title: The Bog Hermit
cards.rules: Read alone what the hermit mutters about, start the clock, then rant about it. The table guesses.
cards.secret: A FROG THAT OWES HIM MONEY.

timer.end: Time. Someone guessed it? Give 3. Nobody did? Drink 3.

cards.title: Swamp Gas
cards.rules: A bubble of swamp gas rises from the mud. Everyone puffs their cheeks; first to laugh drinks 2.

cards.title: The Frog Prince
cards.rules: A frog insists he's a prince, and he would like a kiss. Roll d6.

outcomes.instruction: You kiss him. Still a frog. Drink 3.
You kiss him again, to be sure. Drink 3.
You call him 'Your Highness'. Give 2.
You put him back in his pond. Give 3.
You ask to see his crown. He leaves. Give 3.
He turns into a prince, briefly. Everyone else drinks 1.

cards.title: The Mud Golem
cards.rules: Thumb war with your left neighbor, who plays the mud golem. Best of three. Lose: drink 3.

cards.title: The Bog Body
cards.rules: A body preserved in peat sits up and asks how it looks. Look it over, nod slowly, then roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! You tell it the truth. Drink 6.
You tell it the truth. Drink 3.
You lie beautifully. Give 3, then lie to someone about their outfit.
Natural 20! You call it radiant, and it finally lies back down. Give 6.

jinx.name: Second Opinion
jinx.rule: Anyone who agrees with the cursed player drinks 1.

cards.title: Leeches
cards.rules: Leeches in the water, and they've found the table. Roll four dice.

dice.instruction: They latch onto four seats. You drink {first}; the next three clockwise drink {second}, {third} and {fourth}.

cards.title: The Bog Hag
cards.rules: She lives in a hut on chicken legs and hates visitors. Make your ugliest face, then roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Your face stays like that. Drink 6 while the table watches.
She makes it uglier. Drink 3.
She's charmed, and lets you by. Give 3.
Natural 20! She's charmed, and lets you by. Give 6.

jinx.name: Hag-Ridden
jinx.rule: The cursed player cackles before every sip. Forgets: drink 1.

cards.title: The Lizard Warrior
cards.rules: A lizardfolk warrior, fast as a snake and twice as rude. Roll 2d6.

outcomes.instruction: Bitten. Drink 3.
You disarm him. Karate-chop the air, then give 2.

dice.doubles: You become the lizard. Everyone else drinks 3, silently.

cards.title: The Giant Crab
cards.rules: A giant crab guards the boardwalk. Flick a coaster to the far edge, two tries. Miss: drink 3.

jinx.name: Sideways
jinx.rule: The cursed player looks at people only sideways, like a crab. Caught looking straight: drink 1.

cards.title: The Toad Auction
cards.rules: A toad auctions a jar of glowing swamp water. Bid sips clockwise; top bid drinks them.

cards.title: Five Swamp Things
cards.rules: Name five things that live in a swamp in 10 seconds. Stumble: drink 3.

cards.title: The Ferryman's Song
cards.rules: Pole a mime boat across the marsh, singing, for 15 seconds. Anyone laughs: you drink 3.

cards.title: The Hag's Riddle
cards.rules: Your right neighbor names a creature. Sum it up in one word. Booed: drink 3.

cards.title: Stepping Stones
cards.rules: Balance an empty cup on the back of your hand while the table counts to ten. It falls: drink 3.

cards.title: Popping Pods
cards.rules: A field of seed pods, ripe and ready to burst. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Seeds everywhere. Drink 4.
Seeds everywhere. Drink 2.
You dive behind a log. Give 2 to whoever got splashed.
Natural 20! You dive behind a log. Give 4 to whoever got splashed.

cards.title: The Sinking Bank
cards.rules: The bank under your feet starts sliding into the water. Jump, then roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Into the water. Drink 4.
Into the water. Drink 2.
You surf it out. Give 2 to whoever would have panicked.
Natural 20! You surf it out. Give 4 to whoever would have panicked.

cards.title: Quicksand
cards.rules: The path turns to quicksand under your boots. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Down to your knees. Drink 4.
Down to your knees. Drink 2.
You moonwalk across. Moonwalk to your seat, then give 2.
Natural 20! You moonwalk across. Moonwalk to your seat, then give 4.

cards.title: The Frog Choir
cards.rules: A choir of frogs wants you to join in. Croak a note, then roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! You're in the choir now. Drink 4.
You're in the choir now. Drink 2.
You out-croak them. Give 2.
Natural 20! You out-croak them. Give 4.

cards.title: Bog Imps
cards.rules: Two bog imps stealing boots saw you see them. Whistle innocently, then roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Hush money. Drink 4.
Hush money. Drink 2.
You take a cut. Give 2.
Natural 20! You take a cut. Give 4.

cards.title: The Lost Fisherman
cards.rules: A fisherman is lost in the fog. On three, point at who'd find him first. Most fingers: give 2.

cards.title: The Fog Wraith
cards.rules: A ghost made of marsh fog. You can't see through it, or around it. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! It gets in your lungs. Drink 6.
It gets in your lungs. Drink 3.
You wave it away. Give 3 to whoever looks foggiest right now.
Natural 20! You wave it away. Give 6 to whoever looks foggiest right now.

cards.title: The Gator
cards.rules: An alligator, very calm, until it isn't. Roll d6.

outcomes.instruction: Snap. Drink 3.
It rolls you. Drink 3.
You dodge. Give 2.
You hold its jaws shut. Give 3.
You ride it to shore. Give 3.
It takes a liking to you. Everyone else drinks 1.

cards.title: The Snail Rhyme
cards.rules: Say 'six slimy snails slid slowly south' five times fast. Trip up: drink 3.

cards.title: The Water Snake
cards.rules: A water snake whips across the path. Roll d20 to jump it.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! It wraps your ankles. Drink 4.
It wraps your ankles. Drink 2.
You leap it. Give 2 to whoever jumped.
Natural 20! You leap it. Give 4 to whoever jumped.

cards.title: The Hags' Tea Party
cards.rules: Three hags having tea want your opinion of their brew. All of it. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! You give it. Drink 4.
You give it. Drink 2.
You say 'it's very you', and they cackle off. Give 2.
Natural 20! You say 'it's very you', and they cackle off. Give 4.

cards.title: Lily Pad Hop
cards.rules: Hop across the lily pads for a prize. Win, then cash out or hop again, harder. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Splash. Drink 6.
Splash. Drink 3.
A safe landing. Give 2.
Natural 20! A safe landing. Give 4.

cards.title: The Glowing Pool
cards.rules: A pool of water glowing green. Drink from it, or leave it.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! It was mostly frog. Drink 8.
It was mostly frog. Drink 4.
It's incredible. Name the pool, then give 3.
Natural 20! It's incredible. Name the pool, then give 6.

cards.title: The Sunken Chest
cards.rules: A chest half-sunk in the mud, chained, and something inside it hums. Break in, or don't.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Something bites on the way in. Drink 8.
Something bites on the way in. Drink 4.
A shield, and it's dry. Give 3 to whoever's coldest.
Natural 20! A shield, and it's dry. Give 6 to whoever's coldest.

jinx.name: Mud in the Ears
jinx.rule: The cursed player says 'what?' before answering anyone. Forgets: drink 1.

cards.title: A Smuggler's Jar
cards.rules: A sealed jar in the reeds, and a lucky coin inside it. Flip a pretend coin and call it.

cards.title: The Herbalist's Hut
cards.rules: An empty hut with one potion on the shelf, labeled YOURS. Say thank you to nobody, and keep it.

cards.title: The Fireflies
cards.rules: A clearing full of fireflies. Everyone toasts their left neighbor.

cards.title: The Hag's Apprentice
cards.rules: The hag's apprentice is selling off her potions while she's out.

cards.title: The Eel Seller
cards.rules: He sells eels out of his coat, and wants you to agree they're the best eels.

cards.title: The Dare
cards.rules: The bog folk dare you to cross the rotten plank bridge at night. Nobody ever has.

cards.title: The Ferry
cards.rules: Wade the shallows, or ride the ferry toward the noisy shore.

cards.title: Frog Racing
cards.rules: The bog folk race frogs for prizes. Win, then cash out or bet again, harder. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Your frog wanders off. Drink 6.
Your frog wanders off. Drink 3.
Your frog wins. Give 2.
Natural 20! Your frog wins. Give 4.

cards.title: The Wishing Toad
cards.rules: A giant toad burps up prizes until it burps up you. Cash out or poke it again. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! It swallows your hand. Drink 6.
It swallows your hand. Drink 3.
It burps. Give 2.
Natural 20! It burps. Give 4.

cards.title: Pass the Cup
cards.rules: Pass your drink left; everyone takes one sip of their neighbor's and rates it out of ten.

cards.title: Swamp Names
cards.rules: Go around giving the player on your left a swamp-monster name. The worst one drinks 2.

cards.title: The Mustache
cards.rules: Everyone gives themself a drink mustache. The table picks the best; they give 2.

cards.title: Leech Check
cards.rules: The drawer checks everyone for leeches. Anyone with one takes a sip to get it off.

cards.title: Frog Jump
cards.rules: Glasses up. The drawer croaks three times; the last glass back on the table drinks 2.

elite.title: The Swamp Witch
elite.rules: Forty years in the bog, and you just called her cauldron 'fine'. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! She makes you drink the whole pot. Drink 8.
She makes you drink the whole pot. Drink 4.
You call it her best. She weeps. Give 4.
Natural 20! You call it her best. She weeps. Give 8.

elite.title: The Thing in the Peat
elite.rules: Something has slept in the peat for a thousand years. It's awake. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! It's very old and very strong. Drink 8.
It's very old and very strong. Drink 4.
You bury it again. Give 4 to the oldest player here.
Natural 20! You bury it again. Give 8 to the oldest player here.

spoils.name: Ancient Amulet
spoils.rules: +1 max heart. Every heal heals 1 more.

elite.title: The Lizard King
elite.rules: The lizardfolk's king wants the marsh, one boardwalk at a time. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! He takes your boardwalk. Drink 8.
He takes your boardwalk. Drink 4.
You take his. Take someone's drink for a sip; they drink 4.
Natural 20! You take his. Take someone's drink for a sip; they drink 8.

spoils.name: Scaled Pack
spoils.rules: +1 satchel slot. Comes with a Tower Shield.

elite.title: The Leech Queen
elite.rules: She's fed on every traveler since 1098, and she likes your type. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! She takes a sip of you. Drink 8.
She takes a sip of you. Drink 4.
She asks your blood type. Make one up out loud, then give 4.
Natural 20! She asks your blood type. Make one up out loud, then give 8.

cards.title: The Sunken Chapel
cards.rules: A chapel up to its windows in mud, and the bell still rings. Everyone says 'ding'.

cards.title: The Hag's Bargain
cards.rules: She'll trade something you have for something you need. The drawer shakes her clammy hand.

cards.title: The Ferry of Frogs
cards.rules: A raft poled by frogs, and the fare is a song. Everyone croaks the chorus.

cards.title: The Bog Hydra
cards.rules: Five heads, all hungry, and two of them are arguing. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! A head gets you. Drink 8.
A head gets you. Drink 4.
You cut one off. Two grow back, slower. Give 5.
Natural 20! You tie two heads in a knot. Everyone else drinks 3.

phases.rules: The heads argue over you. Hold one note while the table counts to ten. Run out of air: drink 3.

cards.title: The Frog King
cards.rules: A cart-sized frog in a crown. Side bets: thumbs up or down; wrong bets drink 1. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! He swallows you. Finish your drink.
He sits on you. Drink 4.
You knock his crown into the bog. Give 5.
Natural 20! You knock his crown into the bog. Give 10.

phases.rules: He wants his court flattered. Croak his praises for 15 seconds. Laugh or stall: drink 3.

cards.title: The Drowned Lich
cards.rules: A lich who sank in the marsh and has been complaining ever since. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! He complains until you drown. Drink 8.
He complains until you drown. Drink 4.
You fall asleep, and it bores him to death. Give 5.
Natural 20! You out-complain him. Everyone else drinks 3.

jinx.name: Damp
jinx.rule: Nobody says 'wet'; it's 'damp'. Slip: drink 1.

phases.rules: Name swamp creatures back and forth with your left neighbor. Stall or repeat first: drink 3.

cards.title: The Marsh Serpent
cards.rules: Eight coils, each as thick as a tree. Side bets: thumbs up or down; wrong bets drink 1. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! It pulls you under. Finish your drink.
Squeezed. Drink 4.
You tie its coils in a knot. Give 5.
Natural 20! You tie its coils in a knot. Give 10.

spoils.name: Serpent's Eye
spoils.rules: +2 to ambush d20s. Comes with a Smoke Bomb.

phases.rules: It thrashes, coils everywhere. Roll 2d6 to break free.

outcomes.instruction: Squeezed. Drink 4.
You slip loose. Give 4.

dice.doubles: You tie it to a tree. Give 6.

cards.title: The Baron of the Bog
cards.rules: He just drained half the marsh for a manor, and he's celebrating on you. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! He sprays you with bog water. Drink 8.
He sprays you with bog water. Drink 4.
You read his deed. The marsh owns him. Give 5.
Natural 20! You flood the manor. Everyone else drinks 3.

spoils.name: Baron's Purse
spoils.rules: Comes with a Hired Sword and a Lucky Coin.

phases.rules: He offers you a job at the manor. Roll d6 to negotiate.

outcomes.instruction: Stable hand. Drink 4.
Paid in turnips. Drink 3.
A room and a horse. Give 3.
A title. Give 3.
You buy the manor. Give 4.
You flood it. Everyone else drinks 2.

jinx.name: Lordly
jinx.rule: The cursed player says 'my good fellow' before every sip. Forgets: drink 1.

cards.title: The Shadow
cards.rules: A shadow crosses the sun: {dragon}. Everyone ducks. Last head down drinks 2.

cards.title: A Fallen Scale
cards.rules: A scale the size of a shield, still warm, fallen from {dragon}. Everyone touches it.

cards.title: The Fleeing Knights
cards.rules: Knights gallop past the wrong way, shouting '{dragon}!' Everyone shouts it too.

cards.title: The Burned Mill
cards.rules: A mill, still smoking. {dragon} was here an hour ago. Everyone pours out a sip.

cards.title: Tracks
cards.rules: One footprint, big enough to sit in. Everyone sits in it. Last down drinks 2.

cards.title: The Old Song
cards.rules: A shepherd sings the old song about {dragon}. Everyone hums along. Nobody knows it.

cards.title: The Sleeping Goat
cards.rules: A fat cat on every chair. Everyone gives the cat on their left a noble name.

cards.title: The Crooked Lantern
cards.rules: A crooked inn with a straight fire. Everyone names their best moment of the quest so far.

cards.title: A Hayloft
cards.rules: A barn's hayloft, warm and itchy. Everyone names the animal they'd ride into battle.

cards.title: The Ferry House
cards.rules: The ferryman's inn, and everyone's soaked. Everyone hypes their left neighbor like a herald.

cards.title: A Shepherd's Hut
cards.rules: A shepherd shares his bread and his opinions. Everyone names a snack worth fighting for.

cards.title: The Pilgrims' Rest
cards.rules: A shrine by the door and a bell that rings itself. Everyone says one thing they'd pray for.

cards.title: The Drunken Dwarf
cards.rules: The dwarf who runs it arm-wrestles every guest. Everyone gives their left neighbor a dwarf name.

cards.title: A Painted Wagon
cards.rules: Traveling players let you sleep in their wagon. Everyone strikes a heroic pose on three.

cards.title: The Miller's Plea
cards.rules: A miller begs: a witch took his goat, and the goat is his best friend. Everyone says 'baa' once.

cards.title: The Gingerbread Door
cards.rules: A gingerbread door wants a password. Invent one in 5 seconds and sell it. Table says no: drink 3.

cards.title: The Witch's Cat
cards.rules: A black cat blocks the path and judges you. Do your best cat for 5 seconds, then roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! It's not impressed. Drink 6.
It's not impressed. Drink 3.
It purrs and lets you by. Scratch someone behind the ears; they drink 3.
Natural 20! It purrs and lets you by. Scratch someone behind the ears; they drink 6.

cards.title: The Cauldron
cards.rules: A cauldron of something green, and a ladle. Roll d6.

outcomes.instruction: It tastes like feet. Drink 3.
You turn green for a minute. Drink 3.
Smooth, somehow. Give 2.
You ladle out a round. Give 3.
You find the witch's recipe book. Give 3.
You bottle it and sell it. Everyone else drinks 1.

cards.title: Granny Hex
cards.rules: Three hundred years old, and she has never lost a staring contest. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! She turns you into a toad, briefly. Drink 8.
She turns you into a toad, briefly. Drink 4.
You knock the broom out of her hand. Give 4.
Natural 20! You steal the broom and the goat. Everyone else drinks 3.

jinx.name: Ribbit
jinx.rule: The cursed player says 'ribbit' after every sip. Forgets: drink 1.

spoils.name: Broomstick
spoils.rules: +2 to elite d20s. +1 to ambush d20s.

ally.name: Gertie the Goat
ally.ritual: Everyone bleats when the party heals. Silent: drink 1.

phases.rules: She wants the goat back. Haggle with your left neighbor for ten seconds. Table says no: drink 4.

cards.title: The Signpost
cards.rules: The tower has moved again. Crypt or mines? Everyone votes; the drawer decides.

cards.title: The Wedding Ghosts
cards.rules: The ghosts of a wedding party from 1498 want one more dance. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! You're in the dance. Drink 8 and tell your worst wedding story.
You're in the dance. Drink 4 and tell your worst wedding story.
You lay them to rest with a song. Give 4.
Natural 20! You lay them to rest with a song. Give 8.

cards.title: The Grudge Wraith
cards.rules: A wraith that remembers every wrong ever done to it, and reads the list aloud. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! It reads the ones you did. Finish your drink.
Your name is on it, twice. Drink 4.
You read it a longer list. Give 4 to whoever holds the oldest grudge.
Natural 20! You read it a longer list. Give 8 to whoever holds the oldest grudge.

cards.title: The Skeleton Butler
cards.rules: A skeleton butler insists on announcing you, and gets your name wrong. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Announced as 'Gary'. Drink 8.
Announced as 'Gary'. Drink 4.
You correct him with dignity. Rename someone; they drink 4.
Natural 20! You correct him with dignity. Rename someone; they drink 8.

cards.title: The Vampire Bat
cards.rules: Staring contest with your right neighbor, who plays the bat. Blink or laugh first: drink 3.

jinx.name: Leeched
jinx.rule: Whenever the cursed player sips, their left neighbor sips too. Neighbor forgets: drink 1.

cards.title: The Fortune Teller
cards.rules: A dead fortune teller reads your palm and your diary. Cross your fingers, then roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Doomed. Drink 6, and confess your last secret.
Doomed. Drink 3, and confess your last secret.
You flip her table. Give 4.
Natural 20! You read her fortune back to her. She vanishes in shame. Give 8.

jinx.name: Ill-Fated
jinx.rule: The cursed player says 'I foresaw this' before every sip. Forgets: drink 1.

cards.title: The Vampire Squire
cards.rules: A young vampire who only drinks from knights. Say 'I'm no knight' twice, then roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! He makes an exception. Drink 8.
He makes an exception. Drink 4.
Garlic to the face. He drops something. Give 3.
Natural 20! Garlic to the face. He drops something. Give 6.

cards.title: The Bone Centipede
cards.rules: Something with a hundred bony legs and no manners. Roll 2d6.

outcomes.instruction: It crawls up your sleeve. Drink 4, and shake it out.
You stomp it flat. Give 4.

dice.doubles: A pair! You stomp it with both feet. Everyone else drinks 2.

cards.title: The Sleepy Mummy
cards.rules: On three, point at who'd sleep three thousand years if nobody woke them. Most fingers: drink 3.

cards.title: The Lich's Scribe
cards.rules: The lich's scribe tests you: your left neighbor asks three trivia questions. Miss two: drink 4.

jinx.name: Question Master
jinx.rule: Anyone who answers a question from the cursed player drinks 1.

cards.title: Tomb of Silence
cards.rules: No laughing in the tomb. The table gets 30 seconds to crack you. Laugh: drink 4.

cards.title: The Bone Tower
cards.rules: Stack the empties into a tower that stands for 5 seconds. Collapse: drink 4.

cards.title: Backwards Chant
cards.rules: Wake the dead: say the alphabet from Z to A in 20 seconds. Stumble: drink 4.

cards.title: The Séance
cards.rules: Hands joined, you summon a spirit. Make someone laugh in 20 seconds, or drink 4.

cards.title: Collapsing Floor
cards.rules: The floor gives way. Last to grab the edge of the table with both hands drinks 2.

cards.title: Dart Wall
cards.rules: Little holes in both walls. Then a click. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Darted, in the backside. Drink 6 standing.
Darted, in the backside. Drink 3 standing.
You limbo under them. Give 2.
Natural 20! You limbo under them. Give 4.

cards.title: Fog of Regret
cards.rules: A green fog that smells like your worst night ever. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Flashbacks. Drink 6.
Flashbacks. Drink 3.
You hold your breath. Give 2 to whoever had the worst night.
Natural 20! You hold your breath. Give 4 to whoever had the worst night.

jinx.name: Flashback
jinx.rule: The cursed player shudders at every drink. Forgets: drink 1.

cards.title: Rolling Skull
cards.rules: A giant stone skull rolls down the corridor. Everyone hums doom music while you roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! It rolls you flat. Drink 6.
It rolls you flat. Drink 3.
You dive into a side tomb. Give 2, and take a bow.
Natural 20! You dive into a side tomb. Give 4, and take a bow.

cards.title: Skeleton Crew
cards.rules: A skeleton crew wants a toast off a femur. Rattle your bones, then roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Off the femur. Drink 6.
Off the femur. Drink 3.
You knock their bones loose. Give 3.
Natural 20! You knock their bones loose. Give 6.

cards.title: The Ghoul Choir
cards.rules: Twelve ghouls singing your name, off key. Hum one note with them, then roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! You join in. Drink 6.
You join in. Drink 3.
You conduct them into a wall. Give 3.
Natural 20! You conduct them into a wall. Give 6.

cards.title: The Zombie Lodger
cards.rules: Light the fuse. Pass a cup clockwise, naming a chore you skipped. The zombie bites whoever holds it.

timer.end: It bites. Whoever is holding the cup drinks 3.

cards.title: The Ghoul Knight
cards.rules: A ghoul knight still guarding a king three hundred years gone. He wants a duel. Roll 2d6.

outcomes.instruction: He drops his sword on you. Drink 4.
You out-fence a corpse. Bow, then give 4.

dice.doubles: You salute the dead king, and he lets you pass. Everyone else bows or drinks 4.

cards.title: Skeleton Minstrels
cards.rules: Three skeletons with lutes. Everyone dances for 10 seconds; the worst dancer drinks 3.

cards.title: Your Own Eulogy
cards.rules: Give your own eulogy in 10 seconds. The table says if it moved them. Not moved: drink 4.

cards.title: The Grabbing Hands
cards.rules: Hands grab from every coffin. Roll four dice.

dice.instruction: Four ankles grabbed. You drink {first}; the next three clockwise drink {second}, {third} and {fourth}.

cards.title: The Ghost Hunters
cards.rules: A band of ghost hunters is sure you're a ghost, and they want proof. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! You do the voice. Drink 6, then moan for them.
You do the voice. Drink 3, then moan for them.
You charge them for the sighting. Give 3.
Natural 20! You charge them for the sighting. Give 6.

cards.title: The Bone Dice
cards.rules: A skeleton's finger-bone dice. Win, then cash out or throw again, harder. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Snake eyes. Drink 8.
Snake eyes. Drink 4.
He clacks his jaw. Give 3.
Natural 20! He clacks his jaw. Give 6.

cards.title: Cursed Idol
cards.rules: A gold idol on a plinth. Nothing bad could possibly happen. Grab it, or leave it.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! The plinth bleeds. So do you. Drink 6.
The plinth bleeds. So do you. Drink 3.
Real gold, and something rattling inside. Give 4.
Natural 20! Real gold, and something rattling inside. Give 8.

jinx.name: Idol Worship
jinx.rule: Everyone bows to the cursed player before speaking to them. Forgets: drink 1.

cards.title: The Box of Teeth
cards.rules: A box full of teeth and, at the back, one potion. Shake it, or leave it.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! It tips onto you. Drink 8.
It tips onto you. Drink 4.
Clunk. Give 3 to whoever heard it.
Natural 20! Clunk. Give 6 to whoever heard it.

cards.title: The Sarcophagus
cards.rules: A stone coffin with OPEN ME scratched on the lid, from the inside. Open it, or don't.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Something hugs you. Drink 8.
Something hugs you. Drink 4.
Just a very nice shield. Give 4, then knock on the table twice.
Natural 20! Just a very nice shield. Give 8, then knock on the table twice.

cards.title: The Offering Bowl
cards.rules: A bowl of coins left for the dead, and an untouched potion. Tap the table: a coin for the dead.

cards.title: Candlelit Alcove
cards.rules: Someone left candles and a barrel of clean water. Everyone drinks water. Yes, really.

cards.title: The Ossuary
cards.rules: A banquet hall of bones, shut for centuries, with one last round. Everyone toasts the dead.

cards.title: The Grave Robber
cards.rules: A grave robber with a cart of stolen goods and no questions asked. Prices are firm.

cards.title: The Undertaker
cards.rules: He measures you for a coffin while he sells you things. He's very thorough.

cards.title: The Split
cards.rules: The tunnel splits. Left: silence. Right: drums, chanting, maybe a dance.

cards.title: The Locked Door
cards.rules: A key in the lock, and a sign: DO NOT. Something knocks from the other side.

cards.title: Mimic Coffin
cards.rules: A coffin that coughs up treasure until it bites. Cash out or knock again. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! It bites. Drink 8.
It bites. Drink 4.
It coughs something up. Give 3.
Natural 20! It coughs something up. Give 6.

cards.title: Your Epitaph
cards.rules: Everyone says what their tombstone will say. The table picks the best; they give 3.

cards.title: Skull Face
cards.rules: Everyone pulls their best skull face at once. The table picks the scariest; they give 2.

cards.title: Bone Count
cards.rules: Count off around the table, skipping every multiple of three. Whoever messes up drinks 2.

cards.title: Candlelight
cards.rules: Phone lights up: a moment of silence for the fallen. Anyone who talks drinks 1.

cards.title: Play Dead
cards.rules: On three, everyone plays dead. First to move, laugh or blink drinks 2.

elite.title: The Crypt Matron
elite.rules: The crypt's oldest ghost tends the dead like children. She does not like visitors. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! She tucks you into a coffin. Drink 10, then say goodnight.
She tucks you into a coffin. Drink 5, then say goodnight.
You promise to wipe your feet. She packs you something for the road. Give 5.
Natural 20! You promise to wipe your feet. She packs you something for the road. Give 10.

spoils.name: Matron's Basket
spoils.rules: Every heal heals 1 more. Comes with a Healing Potion.

elite.title: Death's Apprentice
elite.rules: Death's apprentice is behind on his quota, and you'll do. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Collected. Drink 10.
Collected. Drink 5.
You fill out his scrolls wrong. He runs, and drops his hourglass. Give 5.
Natural 20! You fill out his scrolls wrong. He runs, and drops his hourglass. Give 10.

elite.title: The Bone Dragon
elite.rules: A dragon skeleton in a tiny hat, guarding a pile of buttons. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! It lies down on you, hat and all. Drink 10.
It lies down on you, hat and all. Drink 5.
You take the hat. It deflates. Give 5.
Natural 20! You take the hat. It deflates. Give 10.

elite.title: The Banshee Bride
elite.rules: She's been at the altar since 1388, and you look just like him. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! She screams your name. Drink 10.
She screams your name. Drink 5.
You object. She vanishes and drops her ring. Give 5.
Natural 20! You object. She vanishes and drops her ring. Give 10.

spoils.name: Widow's Ring
spoils.rules: +2 to boss d20s. Bosses hurt 1 more.

cards.title: The Dead Ferryman
cards.rules: He'll row you past the worst of the crypt. Everyone closes their eyes for the crossing.

jinx.name: The Ferryman's Due
jinx.rule: The cursed player says 'for the ferryman' before every drink. Forgets: drink 1.

cards.title: The Hall of Kings
cards.rules: Twelve dead kings on twelve thrones, one empty. The drawer stares at it a little too long.

cards.title: The Weeping Statue
cards.rules: A stone queen weeps real tears, and they heal. Everyone keeps a straight face.

jinx.name: Stone Tears
jinx.rule: The cursed player sobs loudly before every drink. Forgets: drink 1.

cards.title: The Bone Golem
cards.rules: Every bone in the crypt, stacked into one angry giant. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! It falls on you. Drink 10.
It falls on you. Drink 5.
You knock out its keystone bone. Give 4.
Natural 20! It collapses into a pile. Everyone else drinks 3.

phases.rules: It pulls itself back together, mostly. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! It groans and falls on you. Drink 10.
It groans and falls on you. Drink 5.
The last bone comes loose. Give 4.
Natural 20! The last bone comes loose. Give 8.

cards.title: The Crypt Guardian
cards.rules: Seven feet of armor at a door. Side bets: thumbs up or down; wrong bets drink 1. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! He throws you out of the crypt. Finish your drink.
He throws you down the stairs. Drink 5.
You get past one arm. Give 4.
Natural 20! You get past one arm. Give 8.

jinx.name: No First Names
jinx.rule: Nobody says a first name. Slip: drink 1.

spoils.name: Guardian's Lantern
spoils.rules: +1 to monster, trap and relic d20s.

phases.rules: Arm-wrestle your left neighbor, playing the guardian. Lose: drink 4.

cards.title: The Dancing Dead
cards.rules: A skeleton fiddler plays the dead to their feet. Everyone dances, then you roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! He plays you off your feet. Drink 10.
He plays you off your feet. Drink 5.
You snap a string. Give 4.
Natural 20! You take the fiddle. Everyone else drinks 3.

spoils.name: The Fiddle
spoils.rules: Natural 20 on a 19 or 20. Every heal heals 1 more.

phases.rules: He plays faster. Freestyle four lines about the table, in rhyme. Stop or stall: drink 4.

cards.title: The Lich Lord
cards.rules: His soul is in a jeweled cup. Side bets: thumbs up or down; wrong bets drink 1. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! You drink his soul. Finish your drink.
His soul is very strong. Drink 5.
You smash the cup. Give 4.
Natural 20! You smash the cup. Give 8.

spoils.name: Phylactery
spoils.rules: −1 max heart. Comes with a Phoenix Feather.

spoils.name: Lich's Crown
spoils.rules: +1 to boss d20s. Natural 20 on a 19 or 20.

phases.rules: He pours his soul into a second cup. Roll d6.

outcomes.instruction: You drink the wrong one. Drink 5.
You drink both. Drink 4.
He drinks yours. Drink 3.
You smash one. Give 3.
You smash both. Give 4.
You make him drink his own soul. Everyone else drinks 2.

jinx.name: Undead
jinx.rule: The cursed player groans like a zombie before every sip. Forgets: drink 1.

cards.title: The Crypt Keeper
cards.rules: Every soul down here owes him a coin, and so do you. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! He collects from you. Drink 10.
He collects from you. Drink 5.
You pay the last toll, and the dead rest. Give 4.
Natural 20! You buy the whole crypt. Everyone else drinks 3.

spoils.name: Grave Goods
spoils.rules: Comes with a Lucky Coin and a Tower Shield.

phases.rules: Name five things buried with a king, in ten seconds. Fall short: drink 4.

jinx.name: Last Rites
jinx.rule: The cursed player says 'rest in peace' whenever a card is put aside. Misses one: drink 1.

cards.title: Goblin Sappers
cards.rules: Three goblins with a barrel of blasting powder and one match. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Boom. Drink 8, and do the explosion with your hands.
Boom. Drink 4, and do the explosion with your hands.
You blow out the match. Give 4.
Natural 20! You blow out the match. Give 8.

cards.title: The Mimic Cart
cards.rules: On three, point at who'd climb into a mine cart that licks its lips. Most fingers: drink 3.

cards.title: The Goblin Miner
cards.rules: A goblin in a lamp-helmet who loves it down here. Loves it. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! He hugs you, helmet and all. Drink 8.
He hugs you, helmet and all. Drink 4.
You blow out his lamp. He leaves something smoky behind. Give 3.
Natural 20! You blow out his lamp. He leaves something smoky behind. Give 6.

cards.title: The Rock Troll
cards.rules: A rock troll wants a flex-off. Everyone flexes; the table picks the weakest flex. They drink 3.

cards.title: The Hungry Goblin
cards.rules: Bread-off: you and your left neighbor mime eating a loaf. Slower, by the table's call: drink 4.

cards.title: The Goblin Alchemist
cards.rules: She brews in the mine's runoff and offers you a sip. Hold your nose, then roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! You sip, and ask for seconds. Drink 6 and say it was lovely.
You sip. Drink 3 and say it tasted fine.
You pour it back. Give 4.
Natural 20! You pour it back. Give 8.

jinx.name: Fumes
jinx.rule: The cursed player can only whisper. Too loud: drink 1.

cards.title: Ooze Pup
cards.rules: A baby ooze made of mine slime. It wants its mother. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! It clings. Drink 6.
It clings. Drink 3.
You scrape it off. Give 4, and make the noise.
Natural 20! You scrape it off. Give 8, and make the noise.

jinx.name: Slimy Fingers
jinx.rule: The cursed player holds their drink with two fingers only. Caught: drink 1.

cards.title: The Four-Armed Ogre
cards.rules: The four-armed ogre arm-wrestles the table, clockwise. Roll four dice.

dice.instruction: Four arms pinned. You drink {first}; the next three clockwise drink {second}, {third} and {fourth}.

cards.title: The Old Dwarf
cards.rules: A dwarf who trained four heroes and got nothing for it. He wants a fight. Roll d6.

outcomes.instruction: Hammered. Drink 4.
He lectures you on gratitude. Drink 4.
You bow first. He respects it. Give 3.
You flip him over his anvil. Give 4.
You thank him. He cries. Give 4.
You do a perfect axe spin. Everyone else drinks 2.

cards.title: The Echo Cave
cards.rules: Your right neighbor echoes everything you say for 20 seconds. You laugh first: drink 4.

jinx.name: Bat Signal
jinx.rule: Whenever the cursed player points at the ceiling, the last to copy drinks 1.

cards.title: Troll Stench
cards.rules: Hold your nose and describe your day for 30 seconds. Let go: drink 4.

cards.title: The Crawlspace
cards.rules: Crawl under the table and out the other side without touching a leg. Touch one: drink 4.

cards.title: Spell the Mine
cards.rules: Say a word starting with each letter of GOBLIN, in order, in 10 seconds. Stumble: drink 4.

cards.title: Mine Cart Race
cards.rules: Race your left neighbor: take a sip, then say 'cart' three times. Slower: drink 4.

cards.title: The Powder Keg
cards.rules: Light the fuse. Pass a cup clockwise, naming a gemstone. The keg blows on whoever holds it.

timer.end: Boom. Whoever is holding the cup drinks 3.

cards.title: The Loose Rail
cards.rules: The rail under your foot isn't attached to anything. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! One leg down a shaft. Drink 6 on one leg.
One leg down a shaft. Drink 3 on one leg.
You hop off. Give 2.
Natural 20! You hop off. Give 4.

cards.title: Fire Damp
cards.rules: Somebody lit a torch. Down here. In the gas. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Whoomph. Drink 6, and pat out your hair.
Whoomph. Drink 3, and pat out your hair.
You dive into a puddle. Give 2 to whoever you blame.
Natural 20! You dive into a puddle. Give 4 to whoever you blame.

cards.title: The Ore Chute
cards.rules: The floor tilts into an ore chute. Lean back in your chair, then roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Down the chute, face first. Drink 6.
Down the chute, face first. Drink 3.
You surf it. Give 2 to the worst surfer here.
Natural 20! You surf it. Give 4 to the worst surfer here.

cards.title: The Kobold Conga
cards.rules: The kobolds are doing a conga line, and now you're in it. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! You conga'd. Drink 6, and lead a conga to the door.
You conga'd. Drink 3, and lead a conga to the door.
You break the line. Give 3.
Natural 20! You break the line. Give 6.

cards.title: The Goblin Gang
cards.rules: Three goblins in stolen armor, one with a very small dagger. Snap your fingers, then roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! They take your purse. Drink 6.
They take your purse. Drink 3.
You out-cool them. Give 3.
Natural 20! You out-cool them. Give 6.

cards.title: The Goblin Boss
cards.rules: A goblin in a big hat says that's a nice drink. Shame if something happened to it. Roll 2d6.

outcomes.instruction: Something happens to it. Drink 4.
You make him an offer. Pick someone to kiss your ring or drink 4.

dice.doubles: He makes you the boss. Everyone else kisses your ring or drinks 4.

cards.title: The Tunnel Spider
cards.rules: Eight legs out of eight tunnels, reaching for drinks. Roll four dice.

dice.instruction: It steals from four glasses. You drink {first}; the next three clockwise drink {second}, {third} and {fourth}.

cards.title: Hold Your Breath
cards.rules: Hold your breath for 20 seconds while the table describes troll breath. Gasp early: drink 4.

cards.title: Falling Rocks
cards.rules: A rock is working itself loose from the ceiling right above you. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! It lands on your foot. Drink 6.
It lands on your foot. Drink 3.
You catch it like a ball. Throw a coaster to someone; they drink 3.
Natural 20! You catch it like a ball. Throw a coaster to someone; they drink 6.

cards.title: Rookie Adventurers
cards.rules: Four rookie adventurers are sure you're the monster at the end of their quest. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! A wooden sword to the face. Drink 6, then growl.
A wooden sword to the face. Drink 3, then growl.
You surrender, and they leave happy. Give 3.
Natural 20! You surrender, and they leave happy. Give 6.

cards.title: A Glint in the Rock
cards.rules: Something gold in a crack in the wall. Reach in, or don't.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Something reaches back. Drink 8.
Something reaches back. Drink 4.
A ring, and a sealed potion. Propose to someone; they drink 4.
Natural 20! A ring, and a sealed potion. Propose to someone; they drink 8.

cards.title: The Lost Strongbox
cards.rules: A strongbox bobbing in a flooded shaft. It could be anything. Fish it out, or let it go.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! It's exactly what you think. Drink 8.
It's exactly what you think. Drink 4.
Gold, and a smoke bomb. Make it rain on someone; they drink 4.
Natural 20! Gold, and a smoke bomb. Make it rain on someone; they drink 8.

jinx.name: Cave Hands
jinx.rule: The cursed player drinks with no hands. Caught using one: drink 1.

cards.title: A Dead Miner's Purse
cards.rules: A dead miner's purse, somehow dry: a candle, a flint and a sellsword's contract. Sign it in the air.

cards.title: The Tool Shed
cards.rules: A miner's helmet on a hook, and a flask of something brown. Put the helmet on: tap your head twice.

cards.title: The Dwarf's Stash
cards.rules: Behind a loose stone, a dwarf's stash and one lucky coin. Knock twice on the table to thank him.

cards.title: The Air Shaft
cards.rules: A shaft overhead and real moonlight. Everyone looks up and makes a wish.

cards.title: The Mole Man
cards.rules: A man who lives down here sells whatever falls down the shafts. He takes drinks, or blood.

cards.title: The Kobold Peddler
cards.rules: A kobold with a bag of pills, potions and one very old book.

cards.title: A Cry for Help
cards.rules: A miner's voice from a collapsed tunnel: 'Help! And bring snacks.'

cards.title: The Flooded Shaft
cards.rules: A dry tunnel, or the flooded shaft, where something big just splashed.

cards.title: The Gem Wheel
cards.rules: A dwarf's wheel of gems, still spinning. Win, then cash out or spin again. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! It flings a rock at you. Drink 8.
It flings a rock at you. Drink 4.
Gems, small ones. Give 3.
Natural 20! Gems, small ones. Give 6.

cards.title: Mimic Mine Cart
cards.rules: A mine cart that spits out loot until it bites. Cash out or knock again. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! It bites. Drink 8.
It bites. Drink 4.
It spits up a prize. Give 3.
Natural 20! It spits up a prize. Give 6.

cards.title: The Rat Race
cards.rules: Bet on a rat in the goblins' race. Win, then cash out or bet again, harder. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Your rat sits down. Drink 8.
Your rat sits down. Drink 4.
Your rat wins by a whisker. Give 3.
Natural 20! Your rat wins by a whisker. Give 6.

cards.title: Worst Smell
cards.rules: Everyone describes the worst thing they've ever smelled. The table gags at the winner, who gives 3.

cards.title: The Canary
cards.rules: A canary flies by. Everyone tweets; the worst tweet drinks 2.

cards.title: Pickaxes
cards.rules: On three, everyone swings a mime pickaxe with both arms. The last one drinks 2.

cards.title: Clean Water
cards.rules: A clean spring. Everyone sips water and says something nice about the person to their right.

cards.title: Down the Shaft
cards.rules: Everyone says the worst thing they ever lost down a hole. The table picks the worst; they drink 2.

elite.title: The Ore Golem
elite.rules: Every bit of ore the goblins ever dropped, fused into one angry golem. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! It falls on you. Drink 10.
It falls on you. Drink 5.
You knock out its core. Inside: something shiny. Don't ask. Give 5.
Natural 20! You knock out its core. Inside: something shiny. Don't ask. Give 10.

spoils.name: Golden Pick
spoils.rules: +2 to ambush d20s. +1 to boss d20s.

elite.title: The Kobold Captain
elite.rules: A kobold in a captain's hat with a tiny cutlass and a big grudge. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Keelhauled, somehow, underground. Drink 10, and say 'aye aye, captain'.
Keelhauled, somehow, underground. Drink 5, and say 'aye aye, captain'.
You take his hat and his cart. Give 5.
Natural 20! You take his hat and his cart. Give 10.

spoils.name: Captain's Hat
spoils.rules: +1 satchel slot. Comes with a Lucky Coin.

elite.title: The Goblin Kingpin
elite.rules: He runs every tunnel from here to the river, and he's heard about you. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! You owe him now. Drink 10.
You owe him now. Drink 5.
You flip him. He works for you now. Give 5.
Natural 20! You flip him. He works for you now. Give 10.
